nl: Identify people close to creators of long comments tagged with a given tag, then count those who studied at a specified university in a specified city.
cypher:
MATCH (t:Tag {name: $tag})<-[:HAS_TAG]-(cmt:Comment)-[:HAS_CREATOR]->(p:Person)-[:KNOWS*1..2]->(fr:Person)
WHERE cmt.length > $minCommentLength
WITH fr, count(DISTINCT cmt) AS c WHERE c > 3
MATCH (fr)-[:STUDY_AT]->(u:University)-[:IS_LOCATED_IN]->(ci:City)
WHERE u.name = $university AND ci.name = $city
RETURN ci.name AS city, u.name AS university, count(DISTINCT fr) AS personCount

nl: Find people near members of recent forums tagged with a given tag, then count those working at a specified company in a specified country.
cypher:
MATCH (t:Tag {name: $tag})<-[:HAS_TAG]-(fo:Forum)-[:HAS_MEMBER]->(p:Person)-[:KNOWS*1..2]->(r:Person)
WHERE fo.creationDate > $forumSince
WITH r, count(DISTINCT fo) AS c WHERE c > 2
MATCH (r)-[:WORK_AT]->(co:Company)-[:IS_LOCATED_IN]->(country:Country)
WHERE co.name = $company AND country.name = $country
RETURN country.name AS country, co.name AS company, count(DISTINCT r) AS workerCount

nl: Select people close to creators of sufficiently long tagged messages, then count posts in a particular forum they moderate by post browser.
cypher:
MATCH (t:Tag {name: $tag})<-[:HAS_TAG]-(m:Message)-[:HAS_CREATOR]->(p:Person)-[:KNOWS*1..2]->(q:Person)
WHERE m.length > $minMessageLength
WITH q, count(DISTINCT m) AS c WHERE c > 10
MATCH (q)<-[:HAS_MODERATOR]-(fo:Forum)-[:CONTAINER_OF]->(po:Post)
WHERE fo.title = $forumTitle AND po.creationDate > $postSince
RETURN fo.title AS forumTitle, po.browserUsed AS browser, count(DISTINCT po) AS postCount

nl: Find people near gender-filtered users interested in enough tags of a tag class, then count their liked comment replies to long posts by browser and location IP.
cypher:
MATCH (t:Tag)-[:HAS_TYPE]->(tc:TagClass), (t)<-[:HAS_INTEREST]-(p:Person)-[:KNOWS*1..2]->(q:Person)
WHERE tc.name = $tagClass AND p.gender = $gender
WITH q, count(DISTINCT t) AS c WHERE c > 2
MATCH (q)-[:LIKES]->(cmt:Comment)-[:REPLY_OF]->(po:Post)
WHERE cmt.creationDate > $commentSince AND po.length > $minPostLength
RETURN po.browserUsed AS browser, q.locationIP AS locationIP, count(DISTINCT cmt) AS likedReplyCount

nl: Find tag names used on recent posts by people born before a cutoff who studied at more than the threshold number of universities, ranked by the number of such alumni authors.
cypher:
MATCH (u:University)<-[:STUDY_AT]-(p:Person)
WHERE p.birthday < $birthday
WITH p, count(u) AS c WHERE c > 2
MATCH (p)<-[:HAS_CREATOR]-(po:Post)-[:HAS_TAG]->(t:Tag)-[:HAS_TYPE]->(tc:TagClass)
WHERE po.creationDate > $postDate AND tc.name = $tagClassName
RETURN t.name AS tagName, count(DISTINCT p) AS alumnusCount
ORDER BY alumnusCount DESC
LIMIT 20

nl: For places hosting more than the threshold number of non-excluded universities, find popular tags of recent forums joined by local people of a given gender.
cypher:
MATCH (u:University)-[:IS_LOCATED_IN]->(pl:Place)
WHERE u.name <> $excludedUniversityName
WITH pl, count(u) AS c WHERE c > 5
MATCH (pl)<-[:IS_LOCATED_IN]-(p:Person)<-[:HAS_MEMBER]-(f:Forum)-[:HAS_TAG]->(t:Tag)
WHERE p.gender = $gender AND f.creationDate > $forumDate
RETURN t.name AS tagName, count(DISTINCT f) AS forumCount
ORDER BY forumCount DESC
LIMIT 20

nl: For cities with more than the threshold number of universities, rank browsers used on liked messages by workers at local organisations.
cypher:
MATCH (u:University)-[:IS_LOCATED_IN]->(ci:City)
WHERE ci.name <> $excludedCityName
WITH ci, count(u) AS c WHERE c > 2
MATCH (ci)<-[:IS_LOCATED_IN]-(o:Organisation)<-[:WORK_AT]-(p:Person)-[:LIKES]->(m:Message)
WHERE o.name <> $excludedOrganisationName AND m.length > $minLength
RETURN m.browserUsed AS messageBrowser, count(DISTINCT p) AS likerCount
ORDER BY likerCount DESC
LIMIT 20

nl: For a named place with more than the threshold number of universities, rank genders of friends reached from employees of local non-excluded companies using a given browser.
cypher:
MATCH (u:University)-[:IS_LOCATED_IN]->(pl:Place)
WHERE pl.name = $placeName
WITH pl, count(u) AS c WHERE c > 2
MATCH (pl)<-[:IS_LOCATED_IN]-(co:Company)<-[:WORK_AT]-(p:Person)-[:KNOWS]->(q:Person)
WHERE co.name <> $excludedCompanyName AND q.browserUsed = $browser
RETURN q.gender AS friendGender, count(DISTINCT p) AS employeeCount
ORDER BY employeeCount DESC
LIMIT 20

nl: Find people most connected within two KNOWS hops to creators of recent posts, then rank the tag names of forums they joined within a specified tag class.
cypher: MATCH (po:Post)-[:HAS_CREATOR]->(a:Person)-[:KNOWS*1..2]->(b:Person) WHERE po.creationDate > $postDate AND po.browserUsed = $postBrowser WITH b, count(po) AS c ORDER BY c DESC LIMIT 100 MATCH (b)<-[:HAS_MEMBER]-(f:Forum)-[:HAS_TAG]->(t:Tag)-[:HAS_TYPE]->(tc:TagClass) WHERE f.creationDate > $forumDate AND tc.name = $tagClassName RETURN t.name AS tagName, count(DISTINCT f) AS forumCount ORDER BY forumCount DESC LIMIT 20

nl: Find people most connected within two KNOWS hops to users who liked long posts, then rank countries by messages located where those people work.
cypher: MATCH (po:Post)<-[:LIKES]-(a:Person)-[:KNOWS*1..2]->(b:Person) WHERE po.length > $minPostLength WITH b, count(a) AS c ORDER BY c DESC LIMIT 10000 MATCH (b)-[:WORK_AT]->(comp:Company)-[:IS_LOCATED_IN]->(country:Country)<-[:IS_LOCATED_IN]-(msg:Message) WHERE msg.creationDate > $messageDate RETURN country.name AS countryName, count(DISTINCT msg) AS messageCount ORDER BY messageCount DESC LIMIT 20

nl: Find people who can reach creators of recent posts by incoming KNOWS paths, then rank the tags on posts that their qualifying comments reply to.
cypher: MATCH (po:Post)-[:HAS_CREATOR]->(a:Person)<-[:KNOWS*1..2]-(b:Person) WHERE a.gender = $gender AND po.creationDate > $postDate WITH b, count(po) AS c ORDER BY c DESC LIMIT 10000 MATCH (b)<-[:HAS_CREATOR]-(com:Comment)-[:REPLY_OF]->(orig:Post)-[:HAS_TAG]->(rt:Tag) WHERE com.length > $commentLength RETURN rt.name AS tagName, count(DISTINCT com) AS commentCount ORDER BY commentCount DESC LIMIT 20

nl: Find people who can reach users that liked older posts, then rank organizations located in the country containing those people’s city.
cypher: MATCH (po:Post)<-[:LIKES]-(a:Person)<-[:KNOWS*1..2]-(b:Person) WHERE po.creationDate < $postBefore WITH b, count(po) AS c ORDER BY c DESC LIMIT 100 MATCH (b)-[:IS_LOCATED_IN]->(city:City)-[:IS_PART_OF]->(country:Country)<-[:IS_LOCATED_IN]-(org:Organisation) WHERE country.name = $countryName RETURN org.name AS organisationName, count(DISTINCT b) AS personCount ORDER BY personCount DESC LIMIT 20

nl: Find people most connected within two KNOWS hops to creators of posts from a given network location, then rank places of messages in forums they moderate.
cypher: MATCH (po:Post)-[:HAS_CREATOR]->(a:Person)-[:KNOWS*1..2]->(b:Person) WHERE po.locationIP = $locationIP WITH b, count(po) AS c ORDER BY c DESC LIMIT 1000 MATCH (b)<-[:HAS_MODERATOR]-(forum:Forum)-[:CONTAINER_OF]->(msg:Message)-[:IS_LOCATED_IN]->(place:Place) WHERE forum.creationDate > $forumDate AND msg.length > $messageLength RETURN place.name AS placeName, count(DISTINCT msg) AS messageCount ORDER BY messageCount DESC LIMIT 20

nl: Identify countries where friends of members of active forums tagged with a selected tag class work, after keeping only friends connected to many such forums.
cypher:
MATCH (tc:TagClass {name: $tagClassName})<-[:HAS_TYPE]-(t:Tag)<-[:HAS_TAG]-(fo:Forum)-[:HAS_MEMBER]->(p:Person)-[:KNOWS*1..2]->(friend:Person)
WHERE fo.creationDate > $forumSince AND fo.title <> $forumTitle
WITH friend, count(DISTINCT fo) AS c WHERE c > 2
MATCH (friend)-[:WORK_AT]->(co:Company)-[:IS_LOCATED_IN]->(country:Country)
WHERE friend.birthday > $birthday
RETURN country.name AS country, count(DISTINCT friend) AS workerCount
ORDER BY workerCount DESC
LIMIT 20

nl: Rank countries by liked comments from people who are within two KNOWS hops of creators of long messages tagged under a given tag class.
cypher:
MATCH (tc:TagClass {name: $tagClassName})<-[:HAS_TYPE]-(t:Tag)<-[:HAS_TAG]-(m:Message)-[:HAS_CREATOR]->(p:Person)-[:KNOWS*1..2]->(f:Person)
WHERE m.length > $minLength
WITH f, count(DISTINCT m) AS c WHERE c > 5
MATCH (f)-[:LIKES]->(cm:Comment)-[:IS_LOCATED_IN]->(country:Country)
WHERE cm.creationDate < $commentBefore AND cm.length > $commentMinLength
RETURN country.name AS country, count(DISTINCT cm) AS likedCommentCount
ORDER BY likedCommentCount DESC
LIMIT 20

nl: Find cities of universities attended by people who are within two KNOWS hops of persons interested in tags from subclasses of a selected tag class.
cypher:
MATCH (tc:TagClass {name: $parentClassName})<-[:IS_SUBCLASS_OF]-(sub:TagClass)<-[:HAS_TYPE]-(t:Tag)<-[:HAS_INTEREST]-(p:Person)-[:KNOWS*1..2]->(f:Person)
WHERE sub.name <> $excludedClassName AND p.gender = $gender
WITH f, count(DISTINCT t) AS c WHERE c > 20
MATCH (f)-[:STUDY_AT]->(u:University)-[:IS_LOCATED_IN]->(city:City)
WHERE f.birthday < $birthday
RETURN city.name AS city, count(DISTINCT f) AS studentCount
ORDER BY studentCount DESC
LIMIT 20

nl: Find prolific long-post authors connected to companies in countries, keep the authors with the highest average post length, then rank the browsers used by their friends of a given gender.
cypher:
MATCH (po:Post)-[:HAS_CREATOR]->(author:Person)-[:WORK_AT]->(co:Company)-[:IS_LOCATED_IN]->(country:Country)
WHERE po.creationDate > $postDate
WITH author, avg(po.length) AS avgPostLength
ORDER BY avgPostLength DESC
LIMIT 10000
MATCH (author)-[:KNOWS]->(friend:Person)
WHERE friend.gender = $gender
RETURN friend.browserUsed AS browser, count(DISTINCT author) AS authorCount
ORDER BY authorCount DESC
LIMIT 20

nl: Identify tags in a given tag hierarchy whose posts are most recent, then rank locations of people born before a date who are interested in those tags.
cypher:
MATCH (po:Post)-[:HAS_TAG]->(tag:Tag)-[:HAS_TYPE]->(tc:TagClass)-[:IS_SUBCLASS_OF]->(parent:TagClass)
WHERE tag.name = $tagName
WITH tag, max(po.creationDate) AS latestPostDate
ORDER BY latestPostDate DESC
LIMIT 1000
MATCH (tag)<-[:HAS_INTEREST]-(person:Person)
WHERE person.birthday < $birthdayBefore
RETURN person.locationIP AS locationIP, count(DISTINCT tag) AS tagCount
ORDER BY tagCount DESC
LIMIT 20

nl: Select people whose replies to posts in cities include the earliest qualifying comments, then rank universities attended by those people while excluding a named university.
cypher:
MATCH (po:Post)<-[:REPLY_OF]-(comment:Comment)-[:HAS_CREATOR]->(person:Person)-[:IS_LOCATED_IN]->(city:City)
WHERE comment.length > $minCommentLength
WITH person, min(comment.creationDate) AS firstReplyDate
ORDER BY firstReplyDate ASC
LIMIT 10
MATCH (person)-[:STUDY_AT]->(university:University)
WHERE university.name <> $excludedUniversity
RETURN university.name AS university, count(DISTINCT person) AS personCount
ORDER BY personCount DESC
LIMIT 20

nl: Rank forums by the average length of their posts among forums created after a date and moderated by company workers, then count matching members by gender.
cypher:
MATCH (po:Post)<-[:CONTAINER_OF]-(forum:Forum)-[:HAS_MODERATOR]->(moderator:Person)-[:WORK_AT]->(company:Company)
WHERE forum.creationDate > $forumDate
WITH forum, avg(po.length) AS avgPostLength
ORDER BY avgPostLength DESC
LIMIT 10000
MATCH (forum)-[:HAS_MEMBER]->(member:Person)
WHERE member.browserUsed = $browser
RETURN member.gender AS gender, count(DISTINCT forum) AS forumCount
ORDER BY forumCount DESC
LIMIT 20

nl: Find places whose residents liked recent posts and whose originating posts are located there, rank places by liked-post length, then list universities in those places.
cypher:
MATCH (po:Post)-[:IS_LOCATED_IN]->(place:Place)<-[:IS_LOCATED_IN]-(person:Person)-[:LIKES]->(liked:Post)
WHERE liked.creationDate > $likedPostDate
WITH place, avg(liked.length) AS avgLikedPostLength
ORDER BY avgLikedPostLength DESC
LIMIT 10
MATCH (place)<-[:IS_LOCATED_IN]-(university:University)
WHERE university.name <> $excludedUniversity
RETURN university.name AS university, count(DISTINCT place) AS placeCount
ORDER BY placeCount DESC
LIMIT 20

nl: Find people who studied at more than a threshold number of non-excluded universities, then count the tags on their recent long liked posts.
cypher:
MATCH (u:University)<-[:STUDY_AT]-(p:Person)
WHERE u.name <> $excludedUniversity
WITH p, count(u) AS c WHERE c > 20
MATCH (p)-[:LIKES]->(po:Post)-[:HAS_TAG]->(t:Tag)
WHERE po.length > $length AND po.creationDate > $postDate
RETURN t.name, count(DISTINCT p) AS alumniCount

nl: Find places with many non-excluded universities, then summarize workers by company and gender at companies located in those places.
cypher:
MATCH (u:University)-[:IS_LOCATED_IN]->(pl:Place)
WHERE u.name <> $excludedUniversity
WITH pl, count(u) AS c WHERE c > 10
MATCH (pl)<-[:IS_LOCATED_IN]-(co:Company)<-[:WORK_AT]-(p:Person)
WHERE co.name <> $excludedCompany AND p.birthday < $birthday
RETURN co.name, p.gender, count(DISTINCT p) AS workerCount

nl: Find places with many universities, then count long comments located in the countries that contain those places, grouped by country and browser.
cypher:
MATCH (u:University)-[:IS_LOCATED_IN]->(pl:Place)
WHERE pl.name <> $excludedPlace
WITH pl, count(u) AS c WHERE c > 10
MATCH (pl)-[:IS_PART_OF]->(co:Country)<-[:IS_LOCATED_IN]-(cm:Comment)
WHERE co.name <> $excludedCountry AND cm.length > $length
RETURN co.name, cm.browserUsed, count(DISTINCT cm) AS commentCount

nl: Find cities with many universities, then count residents with a selected gender by their interests and browser usage.
cypher:
MATCH (u:University)-[:IS_LOCATED_IN]->(ci:City)
WHERE ci.name <> $excludedCity
WITH ci, count(u) AS c WHERE c > 2
MATCH (ci)<-[:IS_LOCATED_IN]-(p:Person)-[:HAS_INTEREST]->(t:Tag)
WHERE p.gender = $gender AND t.name <> $excludedTag
RETURN t.name, p.browserUsed, count(DISTINCT p) AS residentCount

nl: Find employees of a named company who have authored the most tagged posts, then inspect their long comments on tagged posts.
cypher:
MATCH (co:Company {name: $companyName})<-[:WORK_AT]-(p:Person)<-[:HAS_CREATOR]-(po:Post)-[:HAS_TAG]->(t:Tag)
WITH p, count(po) AS c ORDER BY c DESC LIMIT 100
MATCH (p)<-[:HAS_CREATOR]-(cm:Comment)-[:REPLY_OF]->(parent:Post)-[:HAS_TAG]->(rt:Tag)
WHERE cm.length > $length
RETURN p.firstName AS firstName, p.lastName AS lastName, rt.name AS replyTagName, cm.creationDate AS commentCreationDate

nl: Rank people connected to long messages located in the same place as a named company, then list recent forums they belong to and the tags of posts in those forums.
cypher:
MATCH (co:Company)-[:IS_LOCATED_IN]->(pl:Place)<-[:IS_LOCATED_IN]-(m:Message)-[:HAS_CREATOR]->(p:Person)
WHERE co.name = $companyName AND m.length > $minLength
WITH p, count(m) AS c ORDER BY c DESC LIMIT 100
MATCH (p)<-[:HAS_MEMBER]-(fo:Forum)-[:CONTAINER_OF]->(post:Post)-[:HAS_TAG]->(tag:Tag)
WHERE fo.creationDate > $forumDate
RETURN p.firstName AS firstName, p.lastName AS lastName, fo.title AS forumTitle, tag.name AS postTagName, post.creationDate AS postCreationDate

nl: Identify the most common interests among workers of a named company within a tag class, then show forums and moderators associated with those interests.
cypher:
MATCH (co:Company)<-[:WORK_AT]-(p:Person)-[:HAS_INTEREST]->(t:Tag)-[:HAS_TYPE]->(tc:TagClass)
WHERE co.name = $companyName AND tc.name = $tagClassName
WITH t, count(p) AS c ORDER BY c DESC LIMIT 100
MATCH (t)<-[:HAS_TAG]-(fo:Forum)-[:HAS_MODERATOR]->(mod:Person)-[:IS_LOCATED_IN]->(city:City)
WHERE mod.gender = $gender
RETURN t.name AS tagName, fo.title AS forumTitle, mod.firstName AS moderatorFirstName, mod.lastName AS moderatorLastName, city.name AS moderatorCityName

nl: Rank countries by filtered city residents near companies, then explore recent posts liked by people in those top countries.
cypher:
MATCH (co:Company)-[:IS_LOCATED_IN]->(country:Country)<-[:IS_PART_OF]-(city:City)<-[:IS_LOCATED_IN]-(p:Person)
WHERE co.name <> $excludedCompanyName AND p.gender = $gender
WITH country, count(p) AS c ORDER BY c DESC LIMIT 56
MATCH (country)<-[:IS_PART_OF]-(home:City)<-[:IS_LOCATED_IN]-(person:Person)-[:LIKES]->(post:Post)
WHERE post.creationDate > $postDate
RETURN country.name AS countryName, home.name AS cityName, person.firstName AS personFirstName, person.lastName AS personLastName, post.content AS likedPostContent

nl: Find forums with the most members employed by a named company, then list long replies and their authors inside those forums.
cypher:
MATCH (co:Company {name: $companyName})<-[:WORK_AT]-(p:Person)<-[:HAS_MEMBER]-(fo:Forum)-[:HAS_TAG]->(tag:Tag)
WITH fo, count(p) AS c ORDER BY c DESC LIMIT 1000
MATCH (fo)-[:CONTAINER_OF]->(post:Post)<-[:REPLY_OF]-(cm:Comment)-[:HAS_CREATOR]->(author:Person)
WHERE cm.length > $commentLength
RETURN fo.title AS forumTitle, post.content AS postContent, cm.content AS commentContent, author.firstName AS authorFirstName, author.lastName AS authorLastName

nl: Find people reached within one or two outgoing KNOWS hops from creators of recent gender-filtered comments, then rank the post tags used in forums where those people are members.
cypher:
MATCH (c:Comment)-[:HAS_CREATOR]->(p:Person)-[:KNOWS*1..2]->(q:Person)
WHERE c.creationDate > $commentDate AND p.gender = $gender
WITH q, count(DISTINCT c) AS commentCount ORDER BY commentCount DESC LIMIT 100
MATCH (q)<-[:HAS_MEMBER]-(f:Forum)-[:CONTAINER_OF]->(po:Post)-[:HAS_TAG]->(t:Tag)
WHERE f.creationDate > $forumDate AND po.length > $minPostLength
RETURN t.name AS tagName, count(DISTINCT q) AS personCount ORDER BY personCount DESC LIMIT 20

nl: Rank organisations in a target country that employ the top people reached from creators of long comments through one or two KNOWS hops.
cypher:
MATCH (c:Comment)-[:HAS_CREATOR]->(p:Person)-[:KNOWS*1..2]->(q:Person)
WHERE c.length > $minCommentLength AND q.browserUsed = $browser
WITH q, count(DISTINCT c) AS commentCount ORDER BY commentCount DESC LIMIT 10000
MATCH (q)-[:WORK_AT]->(o:Organisation)-[:IS_LOCATED_IN]->(ci:City)-[:IS_PART_OF]->(co:Country)
WHERE co.name = $countryName
RETURN o.name AS organisationName, count(DISTINCT q) AS employeeCount ORDER BY employeeCount DESC LIMIT 20

nl: Identify tags on forums moderated by the top people reached from selected comment creators, restricted to a given forum date range and tag class.
cypher:
MATCH (c:Comment)-[:HAS_CREATOR]->(p:Person)-[:KNOWS*1..2]->(q:Person)
WHERE p.birthday < $birthdayBefore AND c.browserUsed = $commentBrowser
WITH q, count(DISTINCT c) AS commentCount ORDER BY commentCount DESC LIMIT 10
MATCH (q)<-[:HAS_MODERATOR]-(f:Forum)-[:HAS_TAG]->(t:Tag)-[:HAS_TYPE]->(tc:TagClass)
WHERE f.creationDate < $forumBefore AND tc.name = $tagClassName
RETURN t.name AS tagName, count(DISTINCT q) AS moderatorCount ORDER BY moderatorCount DESC LIMIT 20

nl: Rank universities in a chosen country attended by the top people reached from comment creators with a selected IP and gender profile.
cypher:
MATCH (c:Comment)-[:HAS_CREATOR]->(p:Person)-[:KNOWS*1..2]->(q:Person)
WHERE c.locationIP = $locationIP AND q.gender = $gender
WITH q, count(DISTINCT c) AS commentCount ORDER BY commentCount DESC LIMIT 10000
MATCH (q)-[:STUDY_AT]->(u:University)-[:IS_LOCATED_IN]->(ci:City)-[:IS_PART_OF]->(co:Country)
WHERE co.name = $studyCountry
RETURN u.name AS universityName, count(DISTINCT q) AS studentCount ORDER BY studentCount DESC LIMIT 20

nl: Find interest tags held by the top people reached from older comment creators, where those tags also appear on sufficiently long messages in a selected place.
cypher:
MATCH (c:Comment)-[:HAS_CREATOR]->(p:Person)-[:KNOWS*1..2]->(q:Person)
WHERE c.creationDate < $commentBefore AND p.browserUsed = $creatorBrowser
WITH q, count(DISTINCT c) AS commentCount ORDER BY commentCount DESC LIMIT 1000
MATCH (q)-[:HAS_INTEREST]->(t:Tag)<-[:HAS_TAG]-(m:Message)-[:IS_LOCATED_IN]->(pl:Place)
WHERE m.length > $minMessageLength AND pl.name = $placeName
RETURN t.name AS interestTag, count(DISTINCT q) AS interestedPeople ORDER BY interestedPeople DESC LIMIT 20

nl: Find people who wrote many long comments and are interested in a given tag class, then summarize the companies and places where those people work.
cypher: MATCH (cm:Comment)-[:HAS_CREATOR]->(p:Person)-[:HAS_INTEREST]->(t:Tag)-[:HAS_TYPE]->(tc:TagClass) WHERE cm.length > $minCommentLength AND tc.name = $tagClassName WITH p, count(DISTINCT cm) AS c WHERE c > 20 MATCH (p)-[:WORK_AT]->(co:Company)-[:IS_LOCATED_IN]->(pl:Place) WHERE pl.name = $workPlaceName RETURN co.name AS companyName, pl.name AS placeName, count(DISTINCT p) AS personCount

nl: Find post authors in a given city whose posts attracted many recent comment replies, then summarize the tags of forums they moderate.
cypher: MATCH (cm:Comment)-[:REPLY_OF]->(po:Post)-[:HAS_CREATOR]->(p:Person)-[:IS_LOCATED_IN]->(ci:City) WHERE cm.creationDate > $commentSince AND ci.name = $creatorCityName WITH p, count(DISTINCT cm) AS c WHERE c > 20 MATCH (p)<-[:HAS_MODERATOR]-(fo:Forum)-[:HAS_TAG]->(t:Tag) WHERE fo.creationDate > $forumSince AND t.name <> $excludedTagName RETURN t.name AS tagName, count(DISTINCT fo) AS forumCount

nl: Find tags with many short comments under a given parent tag class, then summarize active forum membership by member browser.
cypher: MATCH (cm:Comment)-[:HAS_TAG]->(t:Tag)-[:HAS_TYPE]->(tc:TagClass)-[:IS_SUBCLASS_OF]->(parent:TagClass) WHERE cm.length < $maxCommentLength AND parent.name = $parentClassName WITH t, count(DISTINCT cm) AS c WHERE c > 20 MATCH (t)<-[:HAS_TAG]-(fo:Forum)-[:HAS_MEMBER]->(p:Person) WHERE fo.creationDate > $forumSince AND p.gender = $memberGender RETURN p.browserUsed AS browserUsed, count(DISTINCT fo) AS forumCount

nl: Find universities whose students authored parent comments receiving many long replies, then summarize students from those universities by gender and liked-message browser.
cypher: MATCH (cm:Comment)-[:REPLY_OF]->(pc:Comment)-[:HAS_CREATOR]->(p:Person)-[:STUDY_AT]->(u:University) WHERE cm.length > $replyLength AND pc.creationDate > $parentCommentSince WITH u, count(DISTINCT cm) AS c WHERE c > 20 MATCH (u)<-[:STUDY_AT]-(s:Person)-[:LIKES]->(m:Message) WHERE s.birthday < $birthdayBefore AND m.length > $likedMessageLength RETURN s.gender AS gender, m.browserUsed AS browserUsed, count(DISTINCT s) AS likerCount

nl: Find creators whose messages are located in places with many older comments, then summarize the tagged posts those creators like.
cypher: MATCH (cm:Comment)-[:IS_LOCATED_IN]->(pl:Place)<-[:IS_LOCATED_IN]-(m:Message)-[:HAS_CREATOR]->(p:Person) WHERE cm.creationDate < $commentBefore AND m.length > $messageLength WITH p, count(DISTINCT cm) AS c WHERE c > 5 MATCH (p)-[:LIKES]->(po:Post)-[:HAS_TAG]->(t:Tag) WHERE po.creationDate > $postSince AND t.name = $likedTagName RETURN t.name AS tagName, po.browserUsed AS browserUsed, count(DISTINCT p) AS likerCount

nl: Find countries with many non-excluded companies, then list recent tagged posts from those countries and their creators.
cypher:
MATCH (company:Company)-[:IS_LOCATED_IN]->(country:Country)
WHERE company.name <> $companyName
WITH country, count(company) AS c WHERE c > 2
MATCH (country)<-[:IS_LOCATED_IN]-(post:Post)-[:HAS_CREATOR]->(person:Person)-[:HAS_INTEREST]->(tag:Tag)
WHERE post.creationDate > $postDate AND tag.name = $tagName
RETURN country.name, post.content, post.length, person.firstName, person.lastName, tag.name

nl: Find companies with many employees born before a cutoff, then list messages in the same places as those companies and their tags.
cypher:
MATCH (company:Company)<-[:WORK_AT]-(worker:Person)
WHERE worker.birthday < $birthday
WITH company, count(worker) AS c WHERE c > 2
MATCH (company)-[:IS_LOCATED_IN]->(place:Place)<-[:IS_LOCATED_IN]-(message:Message)-[:HAS_TAG]->(tag:Tag)
WHERE message.length > $messageLength AND tag.name = $tagName
RETURN company.name, place.name, message.content, message.length, tag.name

nl: Find places containing many non-excluded companies, then list forums, members, and tags for people located in those places.
cypher:
MATCH (company:Company)-[:IS_LOCATED_IN]->(place:Place)
WHERE company.name <> $excludedCompanyName
WITH place, count(company) AS c WHERE c > 2
MATCH (place)<-[:IS_LOCATED_IN]-(person:Person)<-[:HAS_MEMBER]-(forum:Forum)-[:HAS_TAG]->(tag:Tag)
WHERE person.gender = $gender AND forum.creationDate > $forumDate AND tag.name = $tagName
RETURN place.name, person.firstName, person.lastName, forum.title, tag.name

nl: Find countries with many matching companies, then list comments from those countries whose authors studied at a selected university.
cypher:
MATCH (company:Company)-[:IS_LOCATED_IN]->(country:Country)
WHERE company.name = $companyName
WITH country, count(company) AS c WHERE c > 10
MATCH (country)<-[:IS_LOCATED_IN]-(comment:Comment)-[:HAS_CREATOR]->(author:Person)-[:STUDY_AT]->(university:University)
WHERE comment.creationDate < $commentDate AND university.name = $universityName
RETURN country.name, comment.content, comment.length, author.firstName, author.lastName, university.name

nl: Find countries with the most cities other than a specified city, then analyze recent posts from those countries by creator gender and return the most common interest tags of their creators.
cypher: MATCH (co:Country)<-[:IS_PART_OF]-(ci:City) WHERE ci.name <> $excludedCity WITH co, count(ci) AS c ORDER BY c DESC LIMIT 6 MATCH (co)<-[:IS_LOCATED_IN]-(po:Post)-[:HAS_CREATOR]->(p:Person)-[:HAS_INTEREST]->(t:Tag) WHERE po.creationDate > $postDate AND p.gender = $gender RETURN t.name AS tagName, count(DISTINCT po) AS postCount

nl: Rank countries by the number of companies excluding a named company, then inspect longer comments from those countries and group them by the commenters' employers and browsers.
cypher: MATCH (co:Country)<-[:IS_LOCATED_IN]-(comp:Company) WHERE comp.name <> $excludedCompany WITH co, count(comp) AS c ORDER BY c DESC LIMIT 22 MATCH (co)<-[:IS_LOCATED_IN]-(cm:Comment)-[:HAS_CREATOR]->(p:Person)-[:WORK_AT]->(org:Organisation) WHERE cm.length > $minCommentLength AND p.browserUsed = $browser RETURN org.name AS organisationName, p.browserUsed AS browserUsed, count(DISTINCT cm) AS commentCount

nl: Select countries with the most long messages, then examine recent comment replies to posts from those countries and count them by tag.
cypher: MATCH (co:Country)<-[:IS_LOCATED_IN]-(m:Message) WHERE m.length > $minMessageLength WITH co, count(m) AS c ORDER BY c DESC LIMIT 56 MATCH (co)<-[:IS_LOCATED_IN]-(po:Post)<-[:REPLY_OF]-(cm:Comment)-[:HAS_TAG]->(t:Tag) WHERE cm.creationDate > $commentDate AND t.name <> $excludedTag RETURN t.name AS tagName, count(DISTINCT cm) AS replyCount

nl: Rank countries by the number of organisations excluding a named organisation, then find forums whose members studied at those organisations and group by organisation and forum title.
cypher: MATCH (co:Country)<-[:IS_LOCATED_IN]-(org0:Organisation) WHERE org0.name <> $excludedOrganisation WITH co, count(org0) AS c ORDER BY c DESC LIMIT 6 MATCH (co)<-[:IS_LOCATED_IN]-(org:Organisation)<-[:STUDY_AT]-(p:Person)<-[:HAS_MEMBER]-(f:Forum) WHERE f.creationDate > $forumDate AND p.birthday < $birthdayCutoff RETURN org.name AS organisationName, f.title AS forumTitle, count(DISTINCT p) AS studentMemberCount

nl: Choose countries with the most contained places excluding a named place, then inspect liked messages from those countries whose likers moderate forums and group by browser and forum title.
cypher: MATCH (co:Country)<-[:IS_PART_OF]-(pl:Place) WHERE pl.name <> $excludedPlace WITH co, count(pl) AS c ORDER BY c DESC LIMIT 56 MATCH (co)<-[:IS_LOCATED_IN]-(msg:Message)<-[:LIKES]-(p:Person)<-[:HAS_MODERATOR]-(f:Forum) WHERE msg.length > $minLikedMessageLength AND f.title <> $excludedForumTitle RETURN p.browserUsed AS browserUsed, f.title AS forumTitle, count(DISTINCT msg) AS likedMessageCount

nl: Find people who created many recent posts in a country, then count the longer comments liked by their one- or two-hop acquaintances by the acquaintances' browser.
cypher:
MATCH (co:Country)<-[:IS_LOCATED_IN]-(po:Post)-[:HAS_CREATOR]->(p:Person)
WHERE co.name = $countryName AND po.creationDate > $postDate
WITH p, count(po) AS c WHERE c > 5
MATCH (p)-[:KNOWS*1..2]->(f:Person)-[:LIKES]->(cm:Comment)
WHERE f.gender = $gender AND cm.length > $commentLength
RETURN f.browserUsed AS browserUsed, count(DISTINCT cm) AS likedCommentCount

nl: Find people with many company jobs in a country, then count which recent forums are moderated by their one- or two-hop acquaintances.
cypher:
MATCH (co:Country)<-[:IS_LOCATED_IN]-(comp:Company)<-[:WORK_AT]-(p:Person)
WHERE co.name = $countryName AND p.birthday > $birthday
WITH p, count(comp) AS c WHERE c > 5
MATCH (p)-[:KNOWS*1..2]->(f:Person)<-[:HAS_MODERATOR]-(fo:Forum)
WHERE f.gender = $gender AND fo.creationDate > $forumDate
RETURN fo.title AS forumTitle, count(DISTINCT f) AS moderatorReachCount

nl: Identify cities in a country with many universities, then group their residents' one- or two-hop acquaintances by city and gender.
cypher:
MATCH (co:Country)<-[:IS_PART_OF]-(ci:City)<-[:IS_LOCATED_IN]-(u:University)
WHERE co.name = $countryName AND u.name <> $excludedUniversityName
WITH ci, count(u) AS c WHERE c > 10
MATCH (ci)<-[:IS_LOCATED_IN]-(p:Person)-[:KNOWS*1..2]->(f:Person)
WHERE p.browserUsed = $browser AND f.birthday < $birthday
RETURN ci.name AS cityName, f.gender AS friendGender, count(DISTINCT f) AS friendCount

nl: Find people reached through local residents in a country, rank them by how many such residents connect to them, then inspect their recent posts and forum tags.
cypher: MATCH (co:Country {name: $countryName})<-[:IS_PART_OF]-(ci:City)<-[:IS_LOCATED_IN]-(p:Person)-[:KNOWS*1..2]->(f:Person) WHERE p.birthday > $birthday WITH f, count(p) AS c ORDER BY c DESC LIMIT 10000 MATCH (f)<-[:HAS_CREATOR]-(po:Post)<-[:CONTAINER_OF]-(fo:Forum)-[:HAS_TAG]->(t:Tag) WHERE po.creationDate > $postDate RETURN f.firstName, f.lastName, po.content, fo.title, t.name

nl: Rank people reached from creators of long messages located in a country, then examine their interests and recent tagged comment replies to posts.
cypher: MATCH (co:Country {name: $countryName})<-[:IS_LOCATED_IN]-(m:Message)-[:HAS_CREATOR]->(p:Person)-[:KNOWS*1..2]->(q:Person) WHERE m.length > $messageLength WITH q, count(m) AS c ORDER BY c DESC LIMIT 100 MATCH (q)-[:HAS_INTEREST]->(t:Tag)<-[:HAS_TAG]-(cm:Comment)-[:REPLY_OF]->(po:Post) WHERE cm.creationDate > $commentDate RETURN q.firstName, q.lastName, t.name, cm.content, po.content

nl: Rank forums connected to friends of people from a country, then inspect substantial contained messages that reply to tagged posts.
cypher: MATCH (co:Country {name: $countryName})<-[:IS_PART_OF]-(ci:City)<-[:IS_LOCATED_IN]-(p:Person)-[:KNOWS*1..2]->(fr:Person)<-[:HAS_MEMBER]-(fo:Forum) WHERE p.gender = $gender AND fo.creationDate > $forumDate WITH fo, count(fr) AS c ORDER BY c DESC LIMIT 100 MATCH (fo)-[:CONTAINER_OF]->(msg:Message)-[:REPLY_OF]->(po:Post)-[:HAS_TAG]->(t:Tag) WHERE msg.length > $messageLength RETURN fo.title, msg.content, po.content, t.name

nl: Rank companies employing friends of people located in cities of a country, then inspect posts located in the same places as those companies and their tags.
cypher: MATCH (co:Country {name: $countryName})<-[:IS_PART_OF]-(ci:City)<-[:IS_LOCATED_IN]-(p:Person)-[:KNOWS*1..2]->(f:Person)-[:WORK_AT]->(comp:Company) WHERE p.browserUsed = $browserUsed AND f.birthday < $birthday WITH comp, count(f) AS c ORDER BY c DESC LIMIT 100 MATCH (comp)-[:IS_LOCATED_IN]->(pl:Place)<-[:IS_LOCATED_IN]-(po:Post)-[:HAS_TAG]->(tag:Tag) WHERE po.length > $postLength RETURN comp.name, pl.name, po.content, tag.name

nl: Find post authors active in sufficiently many tagged forums after a date, then rank the browsers used by their friends of a given gender.
cypher:
MATCH (po:Post)-[:HAS_CREATOR]->(author:Person)<-[:HAS_MEMBER]-(fo:Forum)-[:HAS_TAG]->(t:Tag)
WHERE po.creationDate > $postDate AND t.name = $tagName
WITH author, count(fo) AS c WHERE c > 20
MATCH (author)-[:KNOWS]->(friend:Person)
WHERE friend.gender = $gender
RETURN friend.browserUsed AS browser, count(DISTINCT author) AS authorCount
ORDER BY authorCount DESC
LIMIT 20

nl: Find workers tied to countries that contain many long posts and organisations, then rank browser platforms of long messages they liked.
cypher:
MATCH (po:Post)-[:IS_LOCATED_IN]->(co:Country)<-[:IS_LOCATED_IN]-(org:Organisation)<-[:WORK_AT]-(worker:Person)
WHERE po.length > $minLength AND org.name <> $orgName
WITH worker, count(DISTINCT po) AS c WHERE c > 5
MATCH (worker)-[:LIKES]->(msg:Message)
WHERE msg.length > $likedMinLength
RETURN msg.browserUsed AS browser, count(DISTINCT worker) AS workerCount
ORDER BY workerCount DESC
LIMIT 20

nl: Find tags used by many recent comments replying to posts within a tag class, then rank locations of people interested in those tags.
cypher:
MATCH (po:Post)<-[:REPLY_OF]-(com:Comment)-[:HAS_TAG]->(tag:Tag)-[:HAS_TYPE]->(tc:TagClass)
WHERE com.creationDate > $commentDate AND tc.name = $className
WITH tag, count(com) AS c WHERE c > 10
MATCH (tag)<-[:HAS_INTEREST]-(person:Person)
WHERE person.birthday < $birthday
RETURN person.locationIP AS locationIP, count(DISTINCT tag) AS tagCount
ORDER BY tagCount DESC
LIMIT 20

nl: Find moderators of forums containing many posts who studied at a chosen university, then rank the companies where those moderators work.
cypher:
MATCH (po:Post)<-[:CONTAINER_OF]-(fo:Forum)-[:HAS_MODERATOR]->(mod:Person)-[:STUDY_AT]->(uni:University)
WHERE fo.creationDate > $forumDate AND uni.name = $universityName
WITH mod, count(DISTINCT po) AS c WHERE c > 2
MATCH (mod)-[:WORK_AT]->(comp:Company)
WHERE comp.name <> $companyName
RETURN comp.name AS company, count(DISTINCT mod) AS moderatorCount
ORDER BY moderatorCount DESC
LIMIT 20

nl: Find cities with many people interested in tags attached to long posts, then rank the countries containing those cities.
cypher:
MATCH (po:Post)-[:HAS_TAG]->(tag:Tag)<-[:HAS_INTEREST]-(person:Person)-[:IS_LOCATED_IN]->(city:City)
WHERE po.length > $minPostLength AND tag.name = $tagName
WITH city, count(DISTINCT person) AS c WHERE c > 5
MATCH (city)-[:IS_PART_OF]->(country:Country)
WHERE country.name <> $excludedCountry
RETURN country.name AS country, count(DISTINCT city) AS cityCount
ORDER BY cityCount DESC
LIMIT 20

nl: Find tags with the highest average length of recent posts, then count long posts under those tags by creator browser and gender.
cypher: MATCH (t:Tag)<-[:HAS_TAG]-(po:Post) WHERE po.creationDate > $postDate WITH t, avg(po.length) AS avgPostLength ORDER BY avgPostLength DESC LIMIT 10 MATCH (t)<-[:HAS_TAG]-(p2:Post)-[:HAS_CREATOR]->(creator:Person) WHERE p2.length > $minPostLength RETURN creator.browserUsed AS browserUsed, creator.gender AS gender, count(DISTINCT p2) AS postCount

nl: Rank tags by the longest recent comments attached to them, then count substantial comments for those tags by country.
cypher: MATCH (t:Tag)<-[:HAS_TAG]-(c:Comment) WHERE c.creationDate > $commentDate WITH t, max(c.length) AS maxCommentLength ORDER BY maxCommentLength DESC LIMIT 100 MATCH (t)<-[:HAS_TAG]-(c2:Comment)-[:IS_LOCATED_IN]->(country:Country) WHERE c2.length > $minCommentLength RETURN country.name AS countryName, count(DISTINCT c2) AS commentCount

nl: Find tags with the most recently created messages, then count long reply messages under those tags by the browser and IP of the parent post.
cypher: MATCH (t:Tag)<-[:HAS_TAG]-(m:Message) WHERE m.creationDate > $messageDate WITH t, max(m.creationDate) AS latestMessageDate ORDER BY latestMessageDate DESC LIMIT 10 MATCH (t)<-[:HAS_TAG]-(m2:Message)-[:REPLY_OF]->(parent:Post) WHERE m2.length > $minMessageLength RETURN parent.browserUsed AS parentBrowser, parent.locationIP AS parentLocationIP, count(DISTINCT m2) AS replyCount

nl: Find people who are reached by many gender-filtered acquaintances, then inspect their recent posts in forums and the tags on those forums.
cypher: MATCH (p:Person)-[:KNOWS*1..2]->(f:Person) WHERE p.gender = $gender WITH f, count(p) AS c WHERE c > 3 MATCH (f)<-[:HAS_CREATOR]-(po:Post)<-[:CONTAINER_OF]-(fo:Forum)-[:HAS_TAG]->(t:Tag) WHERE po.creationDate > $postDate RETURN f.firstName, f.lastName, po.content, fo.title, t.name

nl: Find people reached by many acquaintances using a chosen browser, then follow their interests to tagged messages located in places.
cypher: MATCH (p:Person)-[:KNOWS*1..2]->(f:Person) WHERE p.browserUsed = $browser WITH f, count(p) AS c WHERE c > 5 MATCH (f)-[:HAS_INTEREST]->(t:Tag)<-[:HAS_TAG]-(m:Message)-[:IS_LOCATED_IN]->(pl:Place) WHERE m.length > $minLength RETURN f.firstName, f.lastName, t.name, m.content, pl.name

nl: Find people reached by many acquaintances born before a given date, then inspect their university, city, and country for a selected university name.
cypher: MATCH (p:Person)-[:KNOWS*1..2]->(f:Person) WHERE p.birthday < $birthday WITH f, count(p) AS c WHERE c > 2 MATCH (f)-[:STUDY_AT]->(u:University)-[:IS_LOCATED_IN]->(ci:City)-[:IS_PART_OF]->(co:Country) WHERE u.name = $universityName RETURN f.firstName, f.lastName, u.name, ci.name, co.name

nl: Find people reached by many acquaintances from a given IP address, then connect their employers to countries with recent messages.
cypher: MATCH (p:Person)-[:KNOWS*1..2]->(f:Person) WHERE p.locationIP = $locationIP WITH f, count(p) AS c WHERE c > 3 MATCH (f)-[:WORK_AT]->(comp:Company)-[:IS_LOCATED_IN]->(co:Country)<-[:IS_LOCATED_IN]-(m:Message) WHERE m.creationDate > $messageDate RETURN f.firstName, f.lastName, comp.name, co.name, m.content

nl: Find people reached by many acquaintances with a given first name, then inspect substantial comments they liked, the posts replied to, and those posts' tags.
cypher: MATCH (p:Person)-[:KNOWS*1..2]->(f:Person) WHERE p.firstName = $firstName WITH f, count(p) AS c WHERE c > 20 MATCH (f)-[:LIKES]->(cm:Comment)-[:REPLY_OF]->(po:Post)-[:HAS_TAG]->(t:Tag) WHERE cm.length > $commentLength RETURN f.firstName, f.lastName, cm.content, po.content, t.name

nl: Find people who studied at a selected university and joined enough recent forums, then rank their non-excluded interest tags.
cypher:
MATCH (u:University)<-[:STUDY_AT]-(p:Person)<-[:HAS_MEMBER]-(fo:Forum)
WHERE u.name = $universityName AND fo.creationDate > $forumDate
WITH p, count(fo) AS c WHERE c > 5
MATCH (p)-[:HAS_INTEREST]->(t:Tag)
WHERE t.name <> $excludedTagName
RETURN t.name AS interestName, count(DISTINCT p) AS qualifiedPersonCount
ORDER BY qualifiedPersonCount DESC
LIMIT 20

nl: Find companies employing enough alumni born after a given date, then rank the non-excluded countries where those companies are located.
cypher:
MATCH (u:University)<-[:STUDY_AT]-(p:Person)-[:WORK_AT]->(co:Company)
WHERE p.birthday > $birthday AND co.name <> $excludedCompanyName
WITH co, count(p) AS c WHERE c > 10
MATCH (co)-[:IS_LOCATED_IN]->(country:Country)
WHERE country.name <> $excludedCountryName
RETURN country.name AS countryName, count(DISTINCT co) AS companyCount
ORDER BY companyCount DESC
LIMIT 20

nl: Find organisations sharing a specified city with enough universities, then rank browsers used by workers of a selected gender.
cypher:
MATCH (u:University)-[:IS_LOCATED_IN]->(city:City)<-[:IS_LOCATED_IN]-(org:Organisation)
WHERE city.name = $cityName AND org.name <> $excludedOrganisationName
WITH org, count(u) AS c WHERE c > 5
MATCH (org)<-[:WORK_AT]-(p:Person)
WHERE p.gender = $gender
RETURN p.browserUsed AS browser, count(DISTINCT p) AS workerCount
ORDER BY workerCount DESC
LIMIT 20

nl: Find alumni who wrote enough long comments, then rank browsers on recent posts liked by those alumni.
cypher:
MATCH (u:University)<-[:STUDY_AT]-(p:Person)<-[:HAS_CREATOR]-(cmt:Comment)
WHERE u.name <> $excludedUniversityName AND cmt.length > $minCommentLength
WITH p, count(cmt) AS c WHERE c > 2
MATCH (p)-[:LIKES]->(po:Post)
WHERE po.creationDate > $likedPostSince
RETURN po.browserUsed AS browser, count(DISTINCT p) AS likerCount
ORDER BY likerCount DESC
LIMIT 20

nl: Find the top forums containing recent posts with a given tag, then summarize where their moderators' companies are located by country and moderator browser.
cypher:
MATCH (t:Tag {name: $tag})<-[:HAS_TAG]-(po:Post)<-[:CONTAINER_OF]-(f:Forum)
WHERE po.creationDate > $postDate
WITH f, count(po) AS c ORDER BY c DESC LIMIT 10
MATCH (f)-[:HAS_MODERATOR]->(md:Person)-[:WORK_AT]->(co:Company)-[:IS_LOCATED_IN]->(country:Country)
WHERE md.gender = $gender AND co.name <> $companyName
RETURN country.name AS countryName, md.browserUsed AS moderatorBrowser, count(DISTINCT f) AS forumCount

nl: Rank people interested in a given tag by how many long comments they created, then inspect the countries of posts liked by their friends.
cypher:
MATCH (t:Tag {name: $tag})<-[:HAS_INTEREST]-(p:Person)<-[:HAS_CREATOR]-(cm:Comment)
WHERE cm.length > $minLength
WITH p, count(cm) AS c ORDER BY c DESC LIMIT 10000
MATCH (p)-[:KNOWS]->(fr:Person)-[:LIKES]->(po:Post)-[:IS_LOCATED_IN]->(co:Country)
WHERE fr.gender = $gender AND po.creationDate > $likedPostDate
RETURN co.name AS countryName, fr.browserUsed AS friendBrowser, count(DISTINCT p) AS personCount

nl: Choose the top tags sharing a type with a given tag, then summarize messages using those tags by creator city and browser.
cypher:
MATCH (t:Tag {name: $tag})-[:HAS_TYPE]->(tc:TagClass)<-[:HAS_TYPE]-(rt:Tag)
WHERE rt.name <> $excludedTag
WITH rt, count(tc) AS c ORDER BY c DESC LIMIT 1000
MATCH (rt)<-[:HAS_TAG]-(m:Message)-[:HAS_CREATOR]->(creator:Person)-[:IS_LOCATED_IN]->(city:City)
WHERE m.length > $minMessageLength AND creator.gender = $gender
RETURN city.name AS cityName, creator.browserUsed AS creatorBrowser, count(DISTINCT m) AS messageCount

nl: Find top members of recent forums with a given tag, then summarize their universities by country.
cypher:
MATCH (t:Tag {name: $tag})<-[:HAS_TAG]-(fo:Forum)-[:HAS_MEMBER]->(p:Person)
WHERE fo.creationDate > $forumDate
WITH p, count(fo) AS c ORDER BY c DESC LIMIT 1000
MATCH (p)-[:STUDY_AT]->(u:University)-[:IS_LOCATED_IN]->(city:City)-[:IS_PART_OF]->(country:Country)
WHERE u.name <> $universityName AND city.name <> $cityName
RETURN country.name AS countryName, u.name AS universityName, count(DISTINCT p) AS memberCount

nl: Rank posts by the number of recent tagged comments replying to them, then summarize those posts by the authors' workplace locations and gender.
cypher:
MATCH (t:Tag {name: $tag})<-[:HAS_TAG]-(cm:Comment)-[:REPLY_OF]->(po:Post)
WHERE cm.creationDate > $commentDate
WITH po, count(cm) AS c ORDER BY c DESC LIMIT 10000
MATCH (po)-[:HAS_CREATOR]->(author:Person)-[:WORK_AT]->(org:Organisation)-[:IS_LOCATED_IN]->(pl:Place)
WHERE author.browserUsed = $browser AND org.name <> $organisationName
RETURN pl.name AS placeName, author.gender AS authorGender, count(DISTINCT po) AS postCount

nl: Find the most frequent tags on recent posts within a given tag class hierarchy, then return people of a given gender who are interested in those tags.
cypher:
MATCH (po:Post)-[:HAS_TAG]->(t:Tag)-[:HAS_TYPE]->(tc:TagClass)<-[:IS_SUBCLASS_OF]-(sub:TagClass)
WHERE po.creationDate > $postDate AND tc.name = $tagClass
WITH t, count(po) AS c ORDER BY c DESC LIMIT 10
MATCH (t)<-[:HAS_INTEREST]-(person:Person)
WHERE person.gender = $gender
RETURN t.name, person.firstName, person.lastName, person.browserUsed

nl: Rank authors of long posts located through a specified country path, then return companies with a specified name where those authors work.
cypher:
MATCH (po:Post)-[:HAS_CREATOR]->(author:Person)-[:IS_LOCATED_IN]->(city:City)-[:IS_PART_OF]->(country:Country)
WHERE po.length > $minLength AND country.name = $country
WITH author, count(po) AS c ORDER BY c DESC LIMIT 1000
MATCH (author)-[:WORK_AT]->(company:Company)
WHERE company.name = $companyName
RETURN author.firstName, author.lastName, author.browserUsed, company.name

nl: Identify forums with many posts whose members are interested in a chosen tag, then return moderators using a specified browser.
cypher:
MATCH (po:Post)<-[:CONTAINER_OF]-(forum:Forum)-[:HAS_MEMBER]->(member:Person)-[:HAS_INTEREST]->(tag:Tag)
WHERE forum.creationDate < $forumBefore AND tag.name = $interestTag
WITH forum, count(po) AS c ORDER BY c DESC LIMIT 1000
MATCH (forum)-[:HAS_MODERATOR]->(moderator:Person)
WHERE moderator.browserUsed = $browser
RETURN forum.title, forum.creationDate, moderator.firstName, moderator.lastName

nl: Rank cities in a country by posts located in that country and resident activity, then return named organisations located in those cities.
cypher:
MATCH (po:Post)-[:IS_LOCATED_IN]->(country:Country)<-[:IS_PART_OF]-(city:City)<-[:IS_LOCATED_IN]-(resident:Person)
WHERE po.creationDate > $postAfter AND country.name = $country
WITH city, count(po) AS c ORDER BY c DESC LIMIT 100
MATCH (city)<-[:IS_LOCATED_IN]-(org:Organisation)
WHERE org.name = $organisationName
RETURN city.name, org.name

nl: Find people who created many long comments replying to posts while studying at a specified university, then return their liked recent posts.
cypher:
MATCH (po:Post)<-[:REPLY_OF]-(comment:Comment)-[:HAS_CREATOR]->(person:Person)-[:STUDY_AT]->(univ:University)
WHERE comment.length > $minCommentLength AND univ.name = $university
WITH person, count(comment) AS c ORDER BY c DESC LIMIT 1000
MATCH (person)-[:LIKES]->(liked:Post)
WHERE liked.creationDate > $likedAfter
RETURN person.firstName, person.lastName, liked.content, liked.length

nl: Rank universities in a city by matching students of a given gender, then summarize newer alumni by browser.
cypher: MATCH (ci:City {name: $cityName})<-[:IS_LOCATED_IN]-(u:University)<-[:STUDY_AT]-(p:Person) WHERE p.gender = $gender WITH u, count(p) AS c ORDER BY c DESC LIMIT 100 MATCH (u)<-[:STUDY_AT]-(al:Person) WHERE al.birthday > $birthday RETURN al.browserUsed AS browser, count(al) AS alumniCount ORDER BY alumniCount DESC LIMIT 20

nl: Rank countries by company occurrences connected through their cities, then summarize long posts located in those countries by browser.
cypher: MATCH (ci:City)-[:IS_PART_OF]->(co:Country)<-[:IS_LOCATED_IN]-(comp:Company) WHERE ci.name <> $excludedCity AND comp.name <> $excludedCompany WITH co, count(comp) AS c ORDER BY c DESC LIMIT 22 MATCH (co)<-[:IS_LOCATED_IN]-(po:Post) WHERE po.length > $postLength RETURN po.browserUsed AS browser, count(po) AS postCount ORDER BY postCount DESC LIMIT 20

nl: Find prolific recent post creators in a city, then summarize the long comments they like by browser.
cypher: MATCH (ci:City {name: $cityName})<-[:IS_LOCATED_IN]-(p:Person)<-[:HAS_CREATOR]-(po:Post) WHERE po.creationDate > $postSince WITH p, count(po) AS c ORDER BY c DESC LIMIT 100 MATCH (p)-[:LIKES]->(cm:Comment) WHERE cm.length > $commentLength RETURN cm.browserUsed AS browser, count(cm) AS likedCommentCount ORDER BY likedCommentCount DESC LIMIT 20

nl: Find people who create posts with a given tag and are active in forums, then rank the home cities of those top people who are associated with a specified company country path.
cypher:
MATCH (t:Tag {name: $tagName})<-[:HAS_TAG]-(po:Post)-[:HAS_CREATOR]->(p:Person)<-[:HAS_MEMBER]-(fo:Forum)
WHERE po.creationDate > $postDate
WITH p, count(fo) AS c ORDER BY c DESC LIMIT 10
MATCH (p)-[:IS_LOCATED_IN]->(city:City)-[:IS_PART_OF]->(country:Country)<-[:IS_LOCATED_IN]-(co:Company)
WHERE co.name = $companyName
RETURN city.name AS cityName, count(DISTINCT p) AS creatorCount
ORDER BY creatorCount DESC LIMIT 20

nl: Select forums with the most long messages by people interested in a tag, then rank countries where their members liked recent comments.
cypher:
MATCH (t:Tag {name: $tagName})<-[:HAS_INTEREST]-(p:Person)<-[:HAS_CREATOR]-(m:Message)<-[:CONTAINER_OF]-(fo:Forum)
WHERE m.length > $minLength
WITH fo, count(m) AS c ORDER BY c DESC LIMIT 1000
MATCH (fo)-[:HAS_MEMBER]->(member:Person)-[:LIKES]->(cm:Comment)-[:IS_LOCATED_IN]->(co:Country)
WHERE cm.creationDate > $commentDate
RETURN co.name AS countryName, count(DISTINCT fo) AS forumCount
ORDER BY forumCount DESC LIMIT 20

nl: Identify authors receiving many tagged comment replies to their posts, then rank universities attended by those authors in a chosen country.
cypher:
MATCH (t:Tag {name: $tagName})<-[:HAS_TAG]-(cm:Comment)-[:REPLY_OF]->(po:Post)-[:HAS_CREATOR]->(author:Person)
WHERE cm.length > $minCommentLength
WITH author, count(cm) AS c ORDER BY c DESC LIMIT 1000
MATCH (author)-[:STUDY_AT]->(u:University)-[:IS_LOCATED_IN]->(city:City)-[:IS_PART_OF]->(co:Country)
WHERE co.name = $countryName
RETURN u.name AS universityName, count(DISTINCT author) AS authorCount
ORDER BY authorCount DESC LIMIT 20

nl: Rank moderators of recent forums tagged with a given tag, then find the tags most often attached to messages that their recent comments reply to.
cypher:
MATCH (t:Tag {name: $tagName})<-[:HAS_TAG]-(fo:Forum)-[:HAS_MODERATOR]->(mod:Person)-[:IS_LOCATED_IN]->(city:City)
WHERE fo.creationDate > $forumDate
WITH mod, count(fo) AS c ORDER BY c DESC LIMIT 10
MATCH (mod)<-[:HAS_CREATOR]-(cm:Comment)-[:REPLY_OF]->(msg:Message)-[:HAS_TAG]->(replyTag:Tag)
WHERE cm.creationDate > $commentDate
RETURN replyTag.name AS tagName, count(DISTINCT mod) AS moderatorCount
ORDER BY moderatorCount DESC LIMIT 20

nl: Rank employees of non-excluded companies by latest birthday, then count the browser usage of their outgoing friends with the requested gender.
cypher:
MATCH (c:Company)<-[:WORK_AT]-(p:Person)
WHERE c.name <> $excludedCompany
WITH p, max(p.birthday) AS birthdayRank
ORDER BY birthdayRank DESC
LIMIT 10000
MATCH (p)-[:KNOWS]->(f:Person)
WHERE f.gender = $gender
RETURN f.browserUsed AS browser, count(DISTINCT p) AS employeeCount
ORDER BY employeeCount DESC
LIMIT 20

nl: Rank employees from non-excluded companies by oldest birthday, then count which non-excluded universities they studied at.
cypher:
MATCH (c:Company)<-[:WORK_AT]-(p:Person)
WHERE c.name <> $excludedCompany
WITH p, min(p.birthday) AS birthdayRank
ORDER BY birthdayRank ASC
LIMIT 10
MATCH (p)-[:STUDY_AT]->(u:University)
WHERE u.name <> $excludedUniversity
RETURN u.name AS university, count(DISTINCT p) AS employeeCount
ORDER BY employeeCount DESC
LIMIT 20

nl: Rank employees of non-excluded companies by latest birthday, then count the non-excluded cities where those employees are located.
cypher:
MATCH (c:Company)<-[:WORK_AT]-(p:Person)
WHERE c.name <> $excludedCompany
WITH p, max(p.birthday) AS birthdayRank
ORDER BY birthdayRank DESC
LIMIT 100
MATCH (p)-[:IS_LOCATED_IN]->(ci:City)
WHERE ci.name <> $excludedCity
RETURN ci.name AS city, count(DISTINCT p) AS employeeCount
ORDER BY employeeCount DESC
LIMIT 20

nl: Find people who created more than a threshold number of long comments, then return their qualifying forums and forum tags from recently created forums.
cypher: MATCH (cm:Comment)-[:HAS_CREATOR]->(p:Person) WHERE cm.length > $minCommentLength WITH p, count(cm) AS c WHERE c > 10 MATCH (p)<-[:HAS_MEMBER]-(f:Forum)-[:HAS_TAG]->(t:Tag) WHERE f.creationDate > $forumDate AND t.name = $tagName RETURN p.firstName AS firstName, p.lastName AS lastName, f.title AS forumTitle, t.name AS tagName

nl: Find posts that received more than a threshold number of recent comment replies, then return their location hierarchy for posts in a chosen country.
cypher: MATCH (cm:Comment)-[:REPLY_OF]->(po:Post) WHERE cm.creationDate > $commentDate WITH po, count(cm) AS c WHERE c > 20 MATCH (po)-[:IS_LOCATED_IN]->(pl:Place)-[:IS_PART_OF]->(co:Country) WHERE po.creationDate > $postDate AND co.name = $countryName RETURN po.content AS postContent, pl.name AS placeName, co.name AS countryName

nl: Find tags used by more than a threshold number of short comments, then return their tag classes and parent classes matching the class filters.
cypher: MATCH (cm:Comment)-[:HAS_TAG]->(t:Tag) WHERE cm.length < $maxCommentLength WITH t, count(cm) AS c WHERE c > 5 MATCH (t)-[:HAS_TYPE]->(tc:TagClass)-[:IS_SUBCLASS_OF]->(parent:TagClass) WHERE tc.name = $tagClassName AND parent.name <> $excludedParentClass RETURN t.name AS tagName, tc.name AS className, parent.name AS parentClassName

nl: Find places with more than a threshold number of older located comments, then return companies in those places and workers using a specified browser.
cypher: MATCH (cm:Comment)-[:IS_LOCATED_IN]->(pl:Place) WHERE cm.creationDate < $beforeDate WITH pl, count(cm) AS c WHERE c > 20 MATCH (pl)<-[:IS_LOCATED_IN]-(comp:Company)<-[:WORK_AT]-(worker:Person) WHERE comp.name <> $excludedCompanyName AND worker.browserUsed = $browser RETURN pl.name AS placeName, comp.name AS companyName, worker.firstName AS firstName, worker.lastName AS lastName

nl: Find people who liked more than a threshold number of long comments, then return their universities and university cities matching the location filter.
cypher: MATCH (cm:Comment)<-[:LIKES]-(p:Person) WHERE cm.length >= $likedCommentLength WITH p, count(cm) AS c WHERE c > 5 MATCH (p)-[:STUDY_AT]->(u:University)-[:IS_LOCATED_IN]->(city:City) WHERE u.name <> $excludedUniversityName AND city.name = $cityName RETURN p.email AS email, u.name AS universityName, city.name AS cityName

nl: Rank places by the number of non-excluded companies located there, then inspect recent tagged posts created by people in those top places with a selected gender.
cypher:
MATCH (co:Company)-[:IS_LOCATED_IN]->(pl:Place)
WHERE co.name <> $excludedCompanyName
WITH pl, count(co) AS c ORDER BY c DESC LIMIT 100
MATCH (pl)<-[:IS_LOCATED_IN]-(p:Person)<-[:HAS_CREATOR]-(po:Post)-[:HAS_TAG]->(t:Tag)
WHERE p.gender = $gender AND po.creationDate > $postDate
RETURN pl.name AS placeName, p.firstName AS firstName, p.lastName AS lastName, po.content AS postContent, t.name AS tagName

nl: Rank countries by the number of non-excluded companies located there, then find long comments in those countries, their creators, and the creators' interests.
cypher:
MATCH (co:Company)-[:IS_LOCATED_IN]->(cn:Country)
WHERE co.name <> $excludedCompanyName
WITH cn, count(co) AS c ORDER BY c DESC LIMIT 22
MATCH (cn)<-[:IS_LOCATED_IN]-(cm:Comment)-[:HAS_CREATOR]->(p:Person)-[:HAS_INTEREST]->(t:Tag)
WHERE cm.length > $minCommentLength AND p.browserUsed = $browserUsed
RETURN cn.name AS countryName, cm.content AS commentContent, p.firstName AS firstName, p.lastName AS lastName, t.name AS interestName

nl: Rank people by the number of companies they work at after a birthday cutoff, then explore their recent forum memberships and tagged messages in those forums.
cypher:
MATCH (co:Company)<-[:WORK_AT]-(p:Person)
WHERE p.birthday > $birthday
WITH p, count(co) AS c ORDER BY c DESC LIMIT 10000
MATCH (p)<-[:HAS_MEMBER]-(fo:Forum)-[:CONTAINER_OF]->(m:Message)-[:HAS_TAG]->(t:Tag)
WHERE fo.creationDate > $forumDate AND m.length > $minMessageLength
RETURN p.firstName AS firstName, p.lastName AS lastName, fo.title AS forumTitle, m.content AS messageContent, t.name AS tagName

nl: Rank companies by the number of employees of a selected gender, then look at recent local messages in the companies' places that were liked by people from a specified IP.
cypher:
MATCH (co:Company)<-[:WORK_AT]-(p:Person)
WHERE p.gender = $employeeGender
WITH co, count(p) AS c ORDER BY c DESC LIMIT 100
MATCH (co)-[:IS_LOCATED_IN]->(pl:Place)<-[:IS_LOCATED_IN]-(m:Message)<-[:LIKES]-(lp:Person)
WHERE m.creationDate > $messageDate AND lp.locationIP = $locationIP
RETURN co.name AS companyName, pl.name AS placeName, m.content AS messageContent, lp.firstName AS likerFirstName, lp.lastName AS likerLastName

nl: Find the top forum members from recent forums who are interested in a given tag, then summarize where those people studied within a target country.
cypher:
MATCH (fo:Forum)-[:HAS_MEMBER]->(p:Person)-[:HAS_INTEREST]->(t:Tag)
WHERE fo.creationDate > $forumDate AND t.name = $tagName
WITH p, count(fo) AS c ORDER BY c DESC LIMIT 10000
MATCH (p)-[:STUDY_AT]->(u:University)-[:IS_LOCATED_IN]->(city:City)-[:IS_PART_OF]->(co:Country)
WHERE co.name = $countryName AND u.name <> $excludedUniversity
RETURN u.name AS universityName, co.name AS countryName, count(p) AS personCount

nl: Rank tags used in recent forum posts, then inspect the tag-class hierarchy above the top tags.
cypher:
MATCH (fo:Forum)-[:CONTAINER_OF]->(po:Post)-[:HAS_TAG]->(t:Tag)
WHERE po.creationDate > $postDate AND t.name <> $excludedTag
WITH t, count(po) AS c ORDER BY c DESC LIMIT 1000
MATCH (t)-[:HAS_TYPE]->(tc:TagClass)-[:IS_SUBCLASS_OF]->(super:TagClass)-[:IS_SUBCLASS_OF]->(root:TagClass)
WHERE super.name = $superClassName
RETURN super.name AS superClassName, root.name AS rootClassName, count(t) AS tagCount

nl: Select cities whose residents moderate many forums, then count employees using a chosen browser at organizations in the same countries.
cypher:
MATCH (fo:Forum)-[:HAS_MODERATOR]->(mod:Person)-[:IS_LOCATED_IN]->(city:City)
WHERE mod.gender = $moderatorGender
WITH city, count(fo) AS c ORDER BY c DESC LIMIT 100
MATCH (city)-[:IS_PART_OF]->(co:Country)<-[:IS_LOCATED_IN]-(org:Organisation)<-[:WORK_AT]-(employee:Person)
WHERE employee.browserUsed = $browser
RETURN org.name AS organisationName, employee.gender AS employeeGender, count(employee) AS employeeCount

nl: Identify creators of longer forum messages, then summarize the tagged posts they like via comments made after a given date.
cypher:
MATCH (fo:Forum)-[:CONTAINER_OF]->(m:Message)-[:HAS_CREATOR]->(p:Person)
WHERE m.length > $minLength
WITH p, count(m) AS c ORDER BY c DESC LIMIT 1000
MATCH (p)-[:LIKES]->(cm:Comment)-[:REPLY_OF]->(po:Post)-[:HAS_TAG]->(tag:Tag)
WHERE cm.creationDate > $commentDate AND tag.name = $likedTag
RETURN tag.name AS tagName, po.browserUsed AS postBrowser, count(p) AS likerCount

nl: Rank tag classes attached to recent forums, then count messages in a selected place that use tags from those classes.
cypher:
MATCH (fo:Forum)-[:HAS_TAG]->(t:Tag)-[:HAS_TYPE]->(tc:TagClass)
WHERE fo.creationDate > $forumStartDate AND tc.name <> $excludedClass
WITH tc, count(fo) AS c ORDER BY c DESC LIMIT 4
MATCH (tc)<-[:HAS_TYPE]-(tag:Tag)<-[:HAS_TAG]-(msg:Message)-[:IS_LOCATED_IN]->(pl:Place)
WHERE msg.length >= $messageLength AND pl.name = $placeName
RETURN tag.name AS tagName, pl.name AS placeName, count(msg) AS messageCount

nl: Find the most prolific creators of recent posts, then count those top creators by gender when they have a specified interest tag.
cypher:
MATCH (p:Post)-[:HAS_CREATOR]->(creator:Person)
WHERE p.creationDate > $postDate
WITH creator, count(p) AS c ORDER BY c DESC LIMIT 10
MATCH (creator)-[:HAS_INTEREST]->(tag:Tag)
WHERE tag.name = $interestName
RETURN creator.gender AS gender, count(DISTINCT creator) AS creatorCount

nl: Rank tags by how often they appear on long posts, then summarize the retained tags by their tag class while excluding a specified class.
cypher:
MATCH (p:Post)-[:HAS_TAG]->(tag:Tag)
WHERE p.length > $minPostLength
WITH tag, count(p) AS c ORDER BY c DESC LIMIT 1000
MATCH (tag)-[:HAS_TYPE]->(tc:TagClass)
WHERE tc.name <> $excludedTagClassName
RETURN tc.name AS tagClassName, count(tag) AS tagCount

nl: Identify the top countries for posts made with a given browser, then count companies located in those countries excluding a named company.
cypher:
MATCH (p:Post)-[:IS_LOCATED_IN]->(country:Country)
WHERE p.browserUsed = $browserUsed
WITH country, count(p) AS c ORDER BY c DESC LIMIT 56
MATCH (country)<-[:IS_LOCATED_IN]-(company:Company)
WHERE company.name <> $excludedCompanyName
RETURN country.name AS countryName, count(company) AS companyCount

nl: Find forums containing the most posts after a given forum creation date, then count qualifying members by forum title and browser.
cypher:
MATCH (p:Post)<-[:CONTAINER_OF]-(forum:Forum)
WHERE forum.creationDate > $forumDate
WITH forum, count(p) AS c ORDER BY c DESC LIMIT 1000
MATCH (forum)-[:HAS_MEMBER]->(member:Person)
WHERE member.birthday < $birthday
RETURN forum.title AS forumTitle, member.browserUsed AS browserUsed, count(member) AS memberCount

nl: Rank posts by the number of long comments replying to them, then count likes from people of a specified gender by post and liker browser.
cypher:
MATCH (p:Post)<-[:REPLY_OF]-(comment:Comment)
WHERE comment.length > $minCommentLength
WITH p, count(comment) AS c ORDER BY c DESC LIMIT 100
MATCH (p)<-[:LIKES]-(liker:Person)
WHERE liker.gender = $gender
RETURN p.browserUsed AS postBrowserUsed, liker.browserUsed AS likerBrowserUsed, count(liker) AS likeCount

nl: Rank universities by the earliest birthday among selected students, then identify the companies employing students who use a given browser.
cypher: MATCH (u:University)<-[:STUDY_AT]-(s:Person) WHERE s.birthday < $olderThanBirthday WITH u, min(s.birthday) AS earliestStudentBirthday ORDER BY earliestStudentBirthday ASC LIMIT 1000 MATCH (u)<-[:STUDY_AT]-(p:Person)-[:WORK_AT]->(co:Company) WHERE p.browserUsed = $browser AND co.name <> $excludedCompany RETURN u.name AS universityName, co.name AS companyName, count(DISTINCT p) AS employeeStudentCount ORDER BY employeeStudentCount DESC LIMIT 20

nl: Rank universities by the latest birthday among students from non-excluded universities, then count longer comments created by students of a chosen gender.
cypher: MATCH (u:University)<-[:STUDY_AT]-(s:Person) WHERE u.name <> $excludedUniversity WITH u, max(s.birthday) AS latestStudentBirthday ORDER BY latestStudentBirthday DESC LIMIT 1000 MATCH (u)<-[:STUDY_AT]-(p:Person)<-[:HAS_CREATOR]-(c:Comment) WHERE p.gender = $creatorGender AND c.length > $minCommentLength RETURN u.name AS universityName, c.browserUsed AS commentBrowser, count(DISTINCT c) AS commentCount ORDER BY commentCount DESC LIMIT 20

nl: Rank people within one or two KNOWS hops of creators of recent comments, then return the long posts those ranked people liked.
cypher:
MATCH (cm:Comment)-[:HAS_CREATOR]->(creator:Person)-[:KNOWS*1..2]->(q:Person)
WHERE cm.creationDate > $commentAfter
WITH q, count(cm) AS c ORDER BY c DESC LIMIT 10
MATCH (q)-[:LIKES]->(po:Post)
WHERE po.length > $minPostLength
RETURN q.firstName AS personFirstName, q.lastName AS personLastName, po.creationDate AS postCreationDate, po.content AS postContent

nl: Rank people within one or two KNOWS hops of users who liked lengthy comments, then return forums created after a threshold where those ranked people are members.
cypher:
MATCH (cm:Comment)<-[:LIKES]-(liker:Person)-[:KNOWS*1..2]->(q:Person)
WHERE cm.length > $minCommentLength
WITH q, count(cm) AS c ORDER BY c DESC LIMIT 10
MATCH (q)<-[:HAS_MEMBER]-(fo:Forum)
WHERE fo.creationDate > $forumAfter
RETURN q.firstName AS personFirstName, q.lastName AS personLastName, fo.title AS forumTitle, fo.creationDate AS forumCreationDate

nl: Rank people within one or two KNOWS hops of users interested in tags used on comments with a given tag name, then return their matching company workplaces.
cypher:
MATCH (cm:Comment)-[:HAS_TAG]->(tg:Tag)<-[:HAS_INTEREST]-(interested:Person)-[:KNOWS*1..2]->(q:Person)
WHERE tg.name = $commentTagName
WITH q, count(cm) AS c ORDER BY c DESC LIMIT 10
MATCH (q)-[:WORK_AT]->(co:Company)
WHERE co.name = $companyName
RETURN q.firstName AS personFirstName, q.lastName AS personLastName, co.name AS companyName

nl: Rank people within one or two KNOWS hops of authors of posts that received comments from a specified browser, then return the ranked people who have a specified tag interest.
cypher:
MATCH (cm:Comment)-[:REPLY_OF]->(po:Post)-[:HAS_CREATOR]->(author:Person)-[:KNOWS*1..2]->(q:Person)
WHERE cm.browserUsed = $commentBrowser
WITH q, count(cm) AS c ORDER BY c DESC LIMIT 10
MATCH (q)-[:HAS_INTEREST]->(tg:Tag)
WHERE tg.name = $interestTagName
RETURN q.firstName AS personFirstName, q.lastName AS personLastName, tg.name AS tagName

nl: Rank people within one or two KNOWS hops of residents in places where comments are located, then return ranked people located in a specified city.
cypher:
MATCH (cm:Comment)-[:IS_LOCATED_IN]->(pl:Place)<-[:IS_LOCATED_IN]-(resident:Person)-[:KNOWS*1..2]->(q:Person)
WHERE pl.name = $placeName
WITH q, count(cm) AS c ORDER BY c DESC LIMIT 1000
MATCH (q)-[:IS_LOCATED_IN]->(ct:City)
WHERE ct.name = $cityName
RETURN q.firstName AS personFirstName, q.lastName AS personLastName, ct.name AS cityName

nl: Find universities in a specified city above the location threshold, then rank student genders for students born after a given birthday.
cypher:
MATCH (ci:City {name: $city})<-[:IS_LOCATED_IN]-(u:University)
WHERE u.name <> $excludedUniversity
WITH u, count(ci) AS c WHERE c > 3
MATCH (u)<-[:STUDY_AT]-(p:Person)
WHERE p.birthday > $birthday
RETURN p.gender AS gender, count(DISTINCT p) AS studentCount
ORDER BY studentCount DESC
LIMIT 20

nl: Find countries with more than a threshold number of qualifying cities, then rank those countries by recent post volume.
cypher:
MATCH (ci:City)-[:IS_PART_OF]->(co:Country)
WHERE ci.name <> $excludedCity
WITH co, count(ci) AS c WHERE c > 5
MATCH (co)<-[:IS_LOCATED_IN]-(po:Post)
WHERE po.creationDate > $postSince
RETURN co.name AS country, count(DISTINCT po) AS postCount
ORDER BY postCount DESC
LIMIT 20

nl: Find qualifying people located in a specified city and then rank recent forums that have those people as members.
cypher:
MATCH (ci:City {name: $city})<-[:IS_LOCATED_IN]-(p:Person)
WHERE p.birthday > $birthday
WITH p, count(ci) AS c WHERE c > 2
MATCH (p)<-[:HAS_MEMBER]-(fo:Forum)
WHERE fo.creationDate > $forumSince
RETURN fo.title AS forumTitle, count(DISTINCT p) AS memberCount
ORDER BY memberCount DESC
LIMIT 20

nl: Rank authors whose posts are associated with companies in a given country by their average post length, then inspect the interests of the top authors within a selected tag class.
cypher:
MATCH (po:Post)-[:HAS_CREATOR]->(author:Person)-[:WORK_AT]->(comp:Company)-[:IS_LOCATED_IN]->(co:Country)
WHERE co.name = $countryName AND po.creationDate > $postDate
WITH author, avg(po.length) AS avgPostLength
ORDER BY avgPostLength DESC
LIMIT 100
MATCH (author)-[:HAS_INTEREST]->(tag:Tag)-[:HAS_TYPE]->(tc:TagClass)
WHERE tc.name = $tagClassName
RETURN author.firstName, author.lastName, tag.name, tc.name

nl: Find forums with the earliest qualifying posts among forums that have members in a given city, then return their moderators who work for a selected organisation.
cypher:
MATCH (po:Post)<-[:CONTAINER_OF]-(fo:Forum)-[:HAS_MEMBER]->(member:Person)-[:IS_LOCATED_IN]->(city:City)
WHERE fo.creationDate > $forumDate AND city.name = $cityName
WITH fo, min(po.creationDate) AS earliestPostDate
ORDER BY earliestPostDate ASC
LIMIT 100
MATCH (fo)-[:HAS_MODERATOR]->(mod:Person)-[:WORK_AT]->(org:Organisation)
WHERE mod.gender = $gender AND org.name = $organisationName
RETURN fo.title, mod.firstName, mod.lastName, org.name

nl: Rank tags by the latest qualifying post using each tag under a parent tag class, then find people interested in those tags who studied at a selected university.
cypher:
MATCH (po:Post)-[:HAS_TAG]->(tag:Tag)-[:HAS_TYPE]->(tc:TagClass)-[:IS_SUBCLASS_OF]->(parent:TagClass)
WHERE tag.name = $tagName AND po.length > $minLength
WITH tag, max(po.creationDate) AS latestPostDate
ORDER BY latestPostDate DESC
LIMIT 100
MATCH (tag)<-[:HAS_INTEREST]-(person:Person)-[:STUDY_AT]->(uni:University)
WHERE person.birthday < $birthday AND uni.name = $universityName
RETURN tag.name, person.firstName, person.lastName, uni.name

nl: Rank reply creators by the average length of their comments replying to recent posts, then examine tagged messages those creators liked.
cypher:
MATCH (po:Post)<-[:REPLY_OF]-(reply:Comment)-[:HAS_CREATOR]->(creator:Person)-[:IS_LOCATED_IN]->(place:Place)
WHERE po.creationDate > $postDate2 AND place.name = $placeName
WITH creator, avg(reply.length) AS avgReplyLength
ORDER BY avgReplyLength DESC
LIMIT 10000
MATCH (creator)-[:LIKES]->(msg:Message)-[:HAS_TAG]->(tag:Tag)
WHERE msg.creationDate > $messageDate AND tag.name = $likedTagName
RETURN creator.firstName, creator.lastName, msg.content, tag.name

nl: Select countries by the shortest qualifying posts connected to universities in their cities, then return recent comments located in those countries and their creators.
cypher:
MATCH (po:Post)-[:IS_LOCATED_IN]->(co:Country)<-[:IS_PART_OF]-(city:City)<-[:IS_LOCATED_IN]-(uni:University)
WHERE co.name = $countryName2 AND uni.name = $universityName2
WITH co, min(po.length) AS shortestPostLength
ORDER BY shortestPostLength ASC
LIMIT 56
MATCH (co)<-[:IS_LOCATED_IN]-(comment:Comment)-[:HAS_CREATOR]->(person:Person)
WHERE comment.creationDate > $commentDate AND comment.length > $minCommentLength
RETURN co.name, comment.content, person.firstName, person.lastName, person.browserUsed

nl: Find people who created posts with a given tag and are members of many forums, then report the companies where the top such people work for a selected gender.
cypher:
MATCH (t:Tag {name: $postTag})<-[:HAS_TAG]-(po:Post)-[:HAS_CREATOR]->(p:Person)<-[:HAS_MEMBER]-(fo:Forum)
WITH p, count(DISTINCT fo) AS c ORDER BY c DESC LIMIT 1000
MATCH (p)-[:WORK_AT]->(co:Company)
WHERE p.gender = $gender
RETURN co.name AS companyName, count(DISTINCT p) AS personCount
ORDER BY personCount DESC
LIMIT 20

nl: Find forums moderated by people interested in a given tag and containing many posts, then report other tags attached to those top forums.
cypher:
MATCH (t:Tag {name: $interestTag})<-[:HAS_INTEREST]-(p:Person)<-[:HAS_MODERATOR]-(f:Forum)-[:CONTAINER_OF]->(m:Post)
WITH f, count(DISTINCT m) AS c ORDER BY c DESC LIMIT 10000
MATCH (f)-[:HAS_TAG]->(ft:Tag)
WHERE ft.name <> $excludedTag
RETURN ft.name AS forumTagName, count(DISTINCT f) AS forumCount
ORDER BY forumCount DESC
LIMIT 20

nl: Find messages tagged with many tags from the same tag class as a seed tag, then report where sufficiently long top messages are located.
cypher:
MATCH (t:Tag {name: $seedTag})-[:HAS_TYPE]->(tc:TagClass)<-[:HAS_TYPE]-(rt:Tag)<-[:HAS_TAG]-(m:Message)
WITH m, count(DISTINCT rt) AS c ORDER BY c DESC LIMIT 10000
MATCH (m)-[:IS_LOCATED_IN]->(pl:Place)
WHERE m.length > $minLength
RETURN pl.name AS placeName, count(DISTINCT m) AS messageCount
ORDER BY messageCount DESC
LIMIT 20

nl: Find authors of posts that receive many tagged comment replies, then report browser usage among their known people matching a gender filter.
cypher:
MATCH (t:Tag {name: $commentTag})<-[:HAS_TAG]-(cmt:Comment)-[:REPLY_OF]->(po:Post)-[:HAS_CREATOR]->(p:Person)
WITH p, count(DISTINCT cmt) AS c ORDER BY c DESC LIMIT 10
MATCH (p)-[:KNOWS]->(fr:Person)
WHERE fr.gender = $friendGender
RETURN fr.browserUsed AS browserUsed, count(DISTINCT p) AS authorCount
ORDER BY authorCount DESC
LIMIT 20

nl: Find cities containing many members of forums with a given tag, then report universities located in those top member cities.
cypher:
MATCH (t:Tag {name: $forumTag})<-[:HAS_TAG]-(fo:Forum)-[:HAS_MEMBER]->(p:Person)-[:IS_LOCATED_IN]->(ci:City)
WITH ci, count(DISTINCT p) AS c ORDER BY c DESC LIMIT 100
MATCH (ci)<-[:IS_LOCATED_IN]-(u:University)
WHERE u.name <> $excludedUniversity
RETURN u.name AS universityName, count(DISTINCT ci) AS cityCount
ORDER BY cityCount DESC
LIMIT 20

nl: Find the city residents who are members of the most recently created forums, then return their friends with a chosen gender.
cypher:
MATCH (ci:City)<-[:IS_LOCATED_IN]-(p:Person)<-[:HAS_MEMBER]-(fo:Forum)
WHERE fo.creationDate > $forumDate
WITH p, count(fo) AS c ORDER BY c DESC LIMIT 100
MATCH (p)-[:KNOWS]->(friend:Person)
WHERE friend.gender = $gender
RETURN p.firstName, p.lastName, p.browserUsed, friend.firstName, friend.lastName, friend.locationIP

nl: Rank universities in cities by the number of students born after a given date, then return students at those universities using a selected browser.
cypher:
MATCH (ci:City)<-[:IS_LOCATED_IN]-(u:University)<-[:STUDY_AT]-(p:Person)
WHERE p.birthday > $birthday
WITH u, count(p) AS c ORDER BY c DESC LIMIT 1000
MATCH (u)<-[:STUDY_AT]-(student:Person)
WHERE student.browserUsed = $browser
RETURN u.name, student.firstName, student.lastName, student.email

nl: Identify city residents who authored the most long posts, then return their later comments.
cypher:
MATCH (ci:City)<-[:IS_LOCATED_IN]-(p:Person)<-[:HAS_CREATOR]-(po:Post)
WHERE po.length > $minPostLength
WITH p, count(po) AS c ORDER BY c DESC LIMIT 100
MATCH (p)<-[:HAS_CREATOR]-(co:Comment)
WHERE co.creationDate > $commentDate
RETURN p.firstName, p.lastName, co.content, co.length

nl: Find city residents who liked the most sufficiently long messages, then return their interests excluding a chosen tag name.
cypher:
MATCH (ci:City)<-[:IS_LOCATED_IN]-(p:Person)-[:LIKES]->(m:Message)
WHERE m.length > $minMessageLength
WITH p, count(m) AS c ORDER BY c DESC LIMIT 1000
MATCH (p)-[:HAS_INTEREST]->(t:Tag)
WHERE t.name <> $excludedTag
RETURN p.firstName, p.lastName, p.locationIP, t.name

nl: Find the top posters of recent posts located in a given country, then summarize their non-excluded interests by tag and gender.
cypher:
MATCH (co:Country)<-[:IS_LOCATED_IN]-(po:Post)-[:HAS_CREATOR]->(p:Person)
WHERE co.name = $countryName AND po.creationDate > $postDate
WITH p, count(po) AS c ORDER BY c DESC LIMIT 1000
MATCH (p)-[:HAS_INTEREST]->(t:Tag)
WHERE t.name <> $excludedTagName
RETURN t.name AS tagName, p.gender AS gender, count(DISTINCT p) AS personCount

nl: Rank forums by the number of long messages located in a given country, then count those forums by the gender of moderators using a specified browser.
cypher:
MATCH (co:Country)<-[:IS_LOCATED_IN]-(m:Message)<-[:CONTAINER_OF]-(f:Forum)
WHERE co.name = $countryName AND m.length > $minLength
WITH f, count(m) AS c ORDER BY c DESC LIMIT 10000
MATCH (f)-[:HAS_MODERATOR]->(md:Person)
WHERE md.browserUsed = $browserUsed
RETURN md.gender AS moderatorGender, count(DISTINCT f) AS forumCount

nl: Rank tags used on recent messages located in a given country, then summarize the surviving tags by non-excluded tag class.
cypher:
MATCH (co:Country)<-[:IS_LOCATED_IN]-(m:Message)-[:HAS_TAG]->(t:Tag)
WHERE co.name = $countryName AND m.creationDate > $messageDate
WITH t, count(m) AS c ORDER BY c DESC LIMIT 10
MATCH (t)-[:HAS_TYPE]->(tc:TagClass)
WHERE tc.name <> $excludedTagClassName
RETURN tc.name AS tagClassName, count(DISTINCT t) AS tagCount

nl: Find the top cities in a country by number of universities other than an excluded one, then count residents of a given gender by city and browser.
cypher:
MATCH (co:Country)<-[:IS_PART_OF]-(ci:City)<-[:IS_LOCATED_IN]-(u:University)
WHERE co.name = $countryName AND u.name <> $excludedUniversityName
WITH ci, count(u) AS c ORDER BY c DESC LIMIT 100
MATCH (ci)<-[:IS_LOCATED_IN]-(p:Person)
WHERE p.gender = $gender
RETURN ci.name AS cityName, p.browserUsed AS browserUsed, count(p) AS residentCount

nl: Find large companies by older employee counts, then rank tags used on recent posts by gender-filtered employees of those companies.
cypher: MATCH (comp:Company)<-[:WORK_AT]-(p:Person) WHERE p.birthday < $birthCutoff WITH comp, count(p) AS c WHERE c > 3 MATCH (comp)<-[:WORK_AT]-(p2:Person)<-[:HAS_CREATOR]-(po:Post)-[:HAS_TAG]->(t:Tag) WHERE p2.gender = $gender AND po.creationDate > $postSince RETURN t.name AS tagName, count(DISTINCT po) AS postCount ORDER BY postCount DESC LIMIT 20

nl: Select countries with many non-excluded companies, then rank the interest tags of browser-filtered people who liked long messages located in those countries.
cypher: MATCH (comp:Company)-[:IS_LOCATED_IN]->(co:Country) WHERE comp.name <> $excludedCompany WITH co, count(comp) AS c WHERE c > 2 MATCH (co)<-[:IS_LOCATED_IN]-(m:Message)<-[:LIKES]-(p:Person)-[:HAS_INTEREST]->(t:Tag) WHERE m.length > $minLength AND p.browserUsed = $browser RETURN t.name AS interestTag, count(DISTINCT p) AS likerCount ORDER BY likerCount DESC LIMIT 20

nl: Identify places with many companies, then rank browsers used by gender-filtered acquaintances of students at non-excluded universities in those places.
cypher: MATCH (comp:Company)-[:IS_LOCATED_IN]->(pl:Place) WHERE pl.name <> $excludedPlace WITH pl, count(comp) AS c WHERE c > 2 MATCH (pl)<-[:IS_LOCATED_IN]-(u:University)<-[:STUDY_AT]-(p:Person)-[:KNOWS]->(q:Person) WHERE u.name <> $excludedUniversity AND q.gender = $gender RETURN q.browserUsed AS browser, count(DISTINCT p) AS studentCount ORDER BY studentCount DESC LIMIT 20

nl: Find people working at more than a threshold number of non-excluded companies, then rank the browsers of authors whose posts received liked recent comment replies from those people.
cypher: MATCH (comp:Company)<-[:WORK_AT]-(p:Person) WHERE comp.name <> $excludedCompany WITH p, count(comp) AS c WHERE c > 20 MATCH (p)-[:LIKES]->(cm:Comment)-[:REPLY_OF]->(po:Post)-[:HAS_CREATOR]->(author:Person) WHERE cm.creationDate > $commentSince AND author.gender = $authorGender RETURN author.browserUsed AS authorBrowser, count(DISTINCT cm) AS likedReplyCount ORDER BY likedReplyCount DESC LIMIT 20

nl: Rank companies in a target country by the number of employees who have more than a threshold number of non-excluded interests.
cypher: MATCH (t:Tag)<-[:HAS_INTEREST]-(p:Person) WHERE t.name <> $excludedInterestName WITH p, count(t) AS c WHERE c > 20 MATCH (p)-[:WORK_AT]->(co:Company)-[:IS_LOCATED_IN]->(country:Country) WHERE country.name = $countryName AND co.name <> $excludedCompanyName RETURN co.name AS companyName, count(DISTINCT p) AS interestedEmployeeCount ORDER BY interestedEmployeeCount DESC LIMIT 20

nl: For recently created forums with many non-excluded tags, rank browsers used by posts liked by members of a selected gender.
cypher: MATCH (t:Tag)<-[:HAS_TAG]-(f:Forum) WHERE t.name <> $excludedTagName AND f.creationDate > $forumCreatedAfter WITH f, count(t) AS c WHERE c > 2 MATCH (f)-[:HAS_MEMBER]->(member:Person)-[:LIKES]->(liked:Post) WHERE member.gender = $gender AND liked.creationDate > $postCreatedAfter RETURN liked.browserUsed AS browserUsed, count(DISTINCT member) AS memberCount ORDER BY memberCount DESC LIMIT 20

nl: Rank creator browsers for long posts that are replied to by sufficiently long comments carrying many non-excluded tags.
cypher: MATCH (t:Tag)<-[:HAS_TAG]-(cm:Comment) WHERE t.name <> $excludedTagName AND cm.length > $minCommentLength WITH cm, count(t) AS c WHERE c > 2 MATCH (cm)-[:REPLY_OF]->(po:Post)-[:HAS_CREATOR]->(creator:Person) WHERE po.length > $minPostLength AND creator.gender = $gender RETURN creator.browserUsed AS browserUsed, count(DISTINCT cm) AS replyCommentCount ORDER BY replyCommentCount DESC LIMIT 20

nl: For tag classes containing many non-excluded tags, rank the tags in those classes by the number of long recent messages using them.
cypher: MATCH (t:Tag)-[:HAS_TYPE]->(tc:TagClass) WHERE t.name <> $excludedTagName WITH tc, count(t) AS c WHERE c > 20 MATCH (tc)<-[:HAS_TYPE]-(topic:Tag)<-[:HAS_TAG]-(msg:Message) WHERE msg.length > $minMessageLength AND msg.creationDate > $messageCreatedAfter RETURN topic.name AS tagName, count(DISTINCT msg) AS messageCount ORDER BY messageCount DESC LIMIT 20

nl: Find authors with more than a threshold number of long recent posts, then return properties of their one- or two-hop outgoing KNOWS contacts of a given gender.
cypher:
MATCH (po:Post)-[:HAS_CREATOR]->(p:Person)
WHERE po.length > $minPostLength AND po.creationDate > $postDate
WITH p, count(po) AS c WHERE c > 10
MATCH (p)-[:KNOWS*1..2]->(f:Person)
WHERE f.gender = $gender
RETURN p.firstName AS personFirstName, p.lastName AS personLastName, f.firstName AS friendFirstName, f.lastName AS friendLastName, f.browserUsed AS friendBrowserUsed

nl: Find people who liked more than a threshold number of posts from a given IP context, then return properties of their nearby KNOWS contacts using a specified browser.
cypher:
MATCH (po:Post)<-[:LIKES]-(p:Person)
WHERE po.locationIP = $postLocationIP AND po.length > $minPostLength
WITH p, count(po) AS c WHERE c > 5
MATCH (p)-[:KNOWS*1..2]->(f:Person)
WHERE f.browserUsed = $browser
