RETURN p.firstName AS personFirstName, p.lastName AS personLastName, p.browserUsed AS personBrowserUsed, f.firstName AS friendFirstName, f.lastName AS friendLastName, f.locationIP AS friendLocationIP

nl: Find commenters who replied to more than a threshold number of sufficiently long posts, then return properties of their one- or two-hop KNOWS contacts who speak a target language.
cypher:
MATCH (po:Post)<-[:REPLY_OF]-(co:Comment)-[:HAS_CREATOR]->(p:Person)
WHERE po.length > $minPostLength AND co.length > $minCommentLength
WITH p, count(co) AS c WHERE c > 20
MATCH (p)-[:KNOWS*1..2]->(f:Person)
WHERE $language IN f.speaks
RETURN p.firstName AS personFirstName, p.lastName AS personLastName, f.firstName AS friendFirstName, f.lastName AS friendLastName, f.speaks AS friendSpeaks

nl: Find people interested in tags that appear on more than a threshold number of posts with a given tag name, then return properties of their KNOWS-neighborhood contacts from a target network location.
cypher:
MATCH (po:Post)-[:HAS_TAG]->(t:Tag)<-[:HAS_INTEREST]-(p:Person)
WHERE t.name = $tagName AND po.length > $minPostLength
WITH p, count(po) AS c WHERE c > 3
MATCH (p)-[:KNOWS*1..2]->(f:Person)
WHERE f.locationIP = $friendLocationIP
RETURN p.firstName AS personFirstName, p.lastName AS personLastName, f.firstName AS friendFirstName, f.lastName AS friendLastName, f.locationIP AS friendLocationIP

nl: Find prolific post creators after a given date, then rank the tag classes that appear among the interests of their friends of a selected gender.
cypher:
MATCH (po:Post)-[:HAS_CREATOR]->(p:Person)
WHERE po.creationDate > $postDate
WITH p, count(po) AS c WHERE c > 2
MATCH (p)-[:KNOWS]->(f:Person)-[:HAS_INTEREST]->(t:Tag)-[:HAS_TYPE]->(tc:TagClass)
WHERE f.gender = $gender
RETURN tc.name AS tagClassName, count(DISTINCT p) AS creatorCount
ORDER BY creatorCount DESC
LIMIT 20

nl: Find tags used by many recent posts, then rank the places where longer messages carrying those tags were created by their authors.
cypher:
MATCH (po:Post)-[:HAS_TAG]->(t:Tag)
WHERE po.creationDate > $postDate
WITH t, count(po) AS c WHERE c > 3
MATCH (t)<-[:HAS_TAG]-(m:Message)-[:HAS_CREATOR]->(person:Person)-[:IS_LOCATED_IN]->(pl:Place)
WHERE m.length > $messageLength
RETURN pl.name AS placeName, count(DISTINCT m) AS messageCount
ORDER BY messageCount DESC
LIMIT 20

nl: Find countries with many posts from a selected browser, then rank organisations in those countries by the number of comments liked by employees of a selected gender.
cypher:
MATCH (po:Post)-[:IS_LOCATED_IN]->(co:Country)
WHERE po.browserUsed = $browser
WITH co, count(po) AS c WHERE c > 20
MATCH (co)<-[:IS_LOCATED_IN]-(org:Organisation)<-[:WORK_AT]-(person:Person)-[:LIKES]->(cm:Comment)
WHERE person.gender = $gender
RETURN org.name AS organisationName, count(DISTINCT cm) AS likedCommentCount
ORDER BY likedCommentCount DESC
LIMIT 20

nl: Find forums containing many long posts, then rank university cities associated with younger members of those forums.
cypher:
MATCH (po:Post)<-[:CONTAINER_OF]-(fo:Forum)
WHERE po.length > $postLength
WITH fo, count(po) AS c WHERE c > 2
MATCH (fo)-[:HAS_MEMBER]->(member:Person)-[:STUDY_AT]->(u:University)-[:IS_LOCATED_IN]->(ci:City)
WHERE member.birthday > $birthday
RETURN ci.name AS cityName, count(DISTINCT fo) AS forumCount
ORDER BY forumCount DESC
LIMIT 20

nl: Find posts receiving many long comment replies, then rank the parent tag classes of their non-excluded tags.
cypher:
MATCH (po:Post)<-[:REPLY_OF]-(cm:Comment)
WHERE cm.length > $replyLength
WITH po, count(cm) AS c WHERE c > 10
MATCH (po)-[:HAS_TAG]->(t:Tag)-[:HAS_TYPE]->(tc:TagClass)-[:IS_SUBCLASS_OF]->(parent:TagClass)
WHERE t.name <> $tagName
RETURN parent.name AS parentClassName, count(DISTINCT po) AS postCount
ORDER BY postCount DESC
LIMIT 20

nl: Find long, recent posts tagged with a given tag class, rank the posts by average length, then count their creators by workplace company and gender.
cypher:
MATCH (tc:TagClass)<-[:HAS_TYPE]-(t:Tag)<-[:HAS_TAG]-(po:Post)
WHERE tc.name = $tagClassName AND po.creationDate > $postSince
WITH po, avg(po.length) AS avgPostLength
ORDER BY avgPostLength DESC
LIMIT 10000
MATCH (po)-[:HAS_CREATOR]->(p:Person)-[:WORK_AT]->(c:Company)
WHERE p.gender = $gender AND c.name <> $excludedCompany
RETURN c.name AS companyName, p.gender AS gender, count(DISTINCT po) AS postCount

nl: Select substantial comments tagged with a given tag class, rank them by latest creation date, then count those replying to posts in matching countries.
cypher:
MATCH (tc:TagClass)<-[:HAS_TYPE]-(t:Tag)<-[:HAS_TAG]-(cm:Comment)
WHERE tc.name = $tagClassName AND cm.length > $minCommentLength
WITH cm, max(cm.creationDate) AS latestCommentDate
ORDER BY latestCommentDate DESC
LIMIT 100
MATCH (cm)-[:REPLY_OF]->(po:Post)-[:IS_LOCATED_IN]->(co:Country)
WHERE po.creationDate > $postSince AND co.name <> $excludedCountry
RETURN co.name AS countryName, count(DISTINCT cm) AS commentCount

nl: Rank forums tagged with a given tag class by their creation date, then count the ranked forums through members studying at universities.
cypher:
MATCH (tc:TagClass)<-[:HAS_TYPE]-(t:Tag)<-[:HAS_TAG]-(f:Forum)
WHERE tc.name = $tagClassName AND f.creationDate > $forumSince
WITH f, max(f.creationDate) AS latestForumDate
ORDER BY latestForumDate DESC
LIMIT 10
MATCH (f)-[:HAS_MEMBER]->(p:Person)-[:STUDY_AT]->(u:University)
WHERE p.locationIP <> $blockedIP AND u.name <> $excludedUniversity
RETURN u.name AS universityName, p.browserUsed AS browserUsed, count(DISTINCT f) AS forumCount

nl: Find messages under a given tag class, rank them by average message length, then count their creators by city and browser.
cypher:
MATCH (tc:TagClass)<-[:HAS_TYPE]-(t:Tag)<-[:HAS_TAG]-(m:Message)
WHERE tc.name = $tagClassName AND m.length > $minMessageLength
WITH m, avg(m.length) AS avgMessageLength
ORDER BY avgMessageLength DESC
LIMIT 10000
MATCH (m)-[:HAS_CREATOR]->(p:Person)-[:IS_LOCATED_IN]->(ci:City)
WHERE p.birthday < $birthdayBefore AND ci.name <> $excludedCity
RETURN ci.name AS cityName, p.browserUsed AS browserUsed, count(DISTINCT m) AS messageCount

nl: Find people who created posts in more than $n qualifying forums after a given post date, then list their matching interests by tag name.
cypher: MATCH (fo:Forum)-[:CONTAINER_OF]->(po:Post)-[:HAS_CREATOR]->(p:Person) WHERE po.creationDate > $postDate WITH p, count(fo) AS c WHERE c > 2 MATCH (p)-[:HAS_INTEREST]->(t:Tag) WHERE t.name = $tagName RETURN p.firstName AS personFirstName, p.lastName AS personLastName, t.name AS interestName

nl: Find tags of a given tag class used by more than $n forums, then list people of a selected gender who are interested in those tags.
cypher: MATCH (fo:Forum)-[:HAS_TAG]->(t:Tag)-[:HAS_TYPE]->(tc:TagClass) WHERE tc.name = $tagClassName WITH t, count(fo) AS c WHERE c > 20 MATCH (t)<-[:HAS_INTEREST]-(p:Person) WHERE p.gender = $gender RETURN t.name AS tagName, p.firstName AS personFirstName, p.lastName AS personLastName

nl: Find tags attached to long messages in more than $n forum-message occurrences, then list recent comments carrying those tags.
cypher: MATCH (fo:Forum)-[:CONTAINER_OF]->(m:Message)-[:HAS_TAG]->(t:Tag) WHERE m.length > $minLength WITH t, count(m) AS c WHERE c > 3 MATCH (t)<-[:HAS_TAG]-(cmt:Comment) WHERE cmt.creationDate > $commentDate RETURN t.name AS tagName, cmt.content AS commentContent, cmt.length AS commentLength

nl: Find forum moderators using a selected browser who have authored more than $n posts while moderating forums, then list short comments they liked.
cypher: MATCH (fo:Forum)-[:HAS_MODERATOR]->(md:Person)<-[:HAS_CREATOR]-(po:Post) WHERE md.browserUsed = $browser WITH md, count(po) AS c WHERE c > 5 MATCH (md)-[:LIKES]->(cm:Comment) WHERE cm.length < $maxLength RETURN md.firstName AS moderatorFirstName, md.lastName AS moderatorLastName, cm.content AS likedCommentContent

nl: Find the largest non-excluded tag classes by tag count, then count recent tagged messages from those classes by creator demographics.
cypher: MATCH (tc:TagClass)<-[:HAS_TYPE]-(tag:Tag) WHERE tc.name <> $excludedTagClass WITH tc, count(tag) AS c ORDER BY c DESC LIMIT 14 MATCH (tc)<-[:HAS_TYPE]-(messageTag:Tag)<-[:HAS_TAG]-(m:Message)-[:HAS_CREATOR]->(p:Person) WHERE m.creationDate > $messageDate RETURN p.gender AS gender, p.browserUsed AS browser, count(DISTINCT m) AS messageCount

nl: Rank tag classes by number of tags, then find people interested in tags from those classes and count their employers by company and browser.
cypher: MATCH (tc:TagClass)<-[:HAS_TYPE]-(tag:Tag) WHERE tc.name <> $excludedTagClass WITH tc, count(tag) AS c ORDER BY c DESC LIMIT 4 MATCH (tc)<-[:HAS_TYPE]-(interestTag:Tag)<-[:HAS_INTEREST]-(p:Person)-[:WORK_AT]->(company:Company) WHERE p.gender = $gender RETURN company.name AS companyName, p.browserUsed AS browser, count(DISTINCT p) AS interestedWorkers

nl: Select the tag classes with the most allowed tags, then count forums tagged with those classes by moderator attributes.
cypher: MATCH (tc:TagClass)<-[:HAS_TYPE]-(tag:Tag) WHERE tag.name <> $excludedTag WITH tc, count(tag) AS c ORDER BY c DESC LIMIT 36 MATCH (tc)<-[:HAS_TYPE]-(forumTag:Tag)<-[:HAS_TAG]-(f:Forum)-[:HAS_MODERATOR]->(mod:Person) WHERE f.creationDate > $forumDate RETURN mod.gender AS moderatorGender, mod.browserUsed AS moderatorBrowser, count(DISTINCT f) AS forumCount

nl: Rank tag classes by their tag totals, then count long posts tagged with those classes by country and browser.
cypher: MATCH (tc:TagClass)<-[:HAS_TYPE]-(tag:Tag) WHERE tag.name <> $excludedTag WITH tc, count(tag) AS c ORDER BY c DESC LIMIT 14 MATCH (tc)<-[:HAS_TYPE]-(postTag:Tag)<-[:HAS_TAG]-(post:Post)-[:IS_LOCATED_IN]->(country:Country) WHERE post.length > $minLength RETURN country.name AS countryName, post.browserUsed AS browser, count(DISTINCT post) AS postCount

nl: Choose top subclass tag classes by parent-class count, then count recent comments tagged with those subclasses that reply to posts.
cypher: MATCH (parent:TagClass)<-[:IS_SUBCLASS_OF]-(child:TagClass) WHERE parent.name <> $excludedParentClass WITH child, count(parent) AS c ORDER BY c DESC LIMIT 14 MATCH (child)<-[:HAS_TYPE]-(commentTag:Tag)<-[:HAS_TAG]-(comment:Comment)-[:REPLY_OF]->(post:Post) WHERE comment.creationDate > $commentDate RETURN post.browserUsed AS repliedPostBrowser, comment.locationIP AS commenterLocationIP, count(DISTINCT comment) AS replyCount

nl: Rank universities by the earliest birthday among their students, then count recent posts whose tags match the interests of students at those universities by tag name.
cypher: MATCH (u:University)<-[:STUDY_AT]-(al:Person) WITH u, min(al.birthday) AS earliestAlumniBirthday ORDER BY earliestAlumniBirthday ASC LIMIT 10 MATCH (u)<-[:STUDY_AT]-(p:Person)-[:HAS_INTEREST]->(t:Tag)<-[:HAS_TAG]-(m:Post) WHERE p.gender = $gender AND m.creationDate > $postDate RETURN t.name AS tagName, count(DISTINCT m) AS postCount

nl: Select top alumni from a named university by birthday, then count their posts that are contained in forums moderated by people grouped by moderator demographics.
cypher: MATCH (u:University)<-[:STUDY_AT]-(p:Person) WHERE u.name = $universityName WITH p, max(p.birthday) AS birthdayRank ORDER BY birthdayRank DESC LIMIT 10 MATCH (p)<-[:HAS_CREATOR]-(po:Post)<-[:CONTAINER_OF]-(f:Forum)-[:HAS_MODERATOR]->(md:Person) WHERE po.length > $postLength AND f.creationDate > $forumDate RETURN md.browserUsed AS moderatorBrowser, md.gender AS moderatorGender, count(DISTINCT po) AS postCount

nl: Find people who are members of recent forums and created posts with a given tag, then rank the companies in a given country where enough of those people work.
cypher: MATCH (fo:Forum)-[:HAS_MEMBER]->(p:Person)<-[:HAS_CREATOR]-(po:Post)-[:HAS_TAG]->(t:Tag) WHERE fo.creationDate > $forumDate AND t.name = $tagName WITH p, count(DISTINCT fo) AS c WHERE c > 2 MATCH (p)-[:WORK_AT]->(co:Company)-[:IS_LOCATED_IN]->(country:Country) WHERE country.name = $countryName RETURN co.name AS companyName, count(DISTINCT p) AS qualifyingPeople ORDER BY qualifyingPeople DESC LIMIT 20

nl: Find creators of long messages in forums tied to a specified city, then rank their interest tags within a specified tag class.
cypher: MATCH (fo:Forum)-[:CONTAINER_OF]->(m:Message)-[:HAS_CREATOR]->(p:Person)-[:IS_LOCATED_IN]->(city:City) WHERE m.length > $minLength AND city.name = $cityName WITH p, count(DISTINCT m) AS c WHERE c > 10 MATCH (p)-[:HAS_INTEREST]->(tag:Tag)-[:HAS_TYPE]->(tc:TagClass) WHERE tc.name = $tagClassName RETURN tag.name AS interestTag, count(DISTINCT p) AS creatorCount ORDER BY creatorCount DESC LIMIT 20

nl: Find moderators of a named forum who have authored many long comments, then rank the places of universities where those moderators studied.
cypher: MATCH (fo:Forum)-[:HAS_MODERATOR]->(mod:Person)<-[:HAS_CREATOR]-(cmt:Comment)-[:IS_LOCATED_IN]->(country:Country) WHERE fo.title = $forumTitle AND cmt.length > $minCommentLength WITH mod, count(DISTINCT cmt) AS c WHERE c > 10 MATCH (mod)-[:STUDY_AT]->(uni:University)-[:IS_LOCATED_IN]->(place:Place) WHERE uni.name = $universityName RETURN place.name AS universityPlace, count(DISTINCT mod) AS moderatorCount ORDER BY moderatorCount DESC LIMIT 20

nl: Find tags used by older forums and posts located in a given country, then rank browsers of people interested in those tags who liked long messages.
cypher: MATCH (fo:Forum)-[:HAS_TAG]->(t:Tag)<-[:HAS_TAG]-(po:Post)-[:IS_LOCATED_IN]->(country:Country) WHERE fo.creationDate < $beforeDate AND country.name = $countryName WITH t, count(DISTINCT po) AS c WHERE c > 5 MATCH (t)<-[:HAS_INTEREST]-(p:Person)-[:LIKES]->(msg:Message) WHERE msg.length > $minLikedLength RETURN p.browserUsed AS browser, count(DISTINCT msg) AS likedMessageCount ORDER BY likedMessageCount DESC LIMIT 20

nl: Find people who made many long replies to recent posts in forums, then rank tags on older posts liked by those people.
cypher: MATCH (fo:Forum)-[:CONTAINER_OF]->(post:Post)<-[:REPLY_OF]-(reply:Comment)-[:HAS_CREATOR]->(p:Person) WHERE post.creationDate > $postDate AND reply.length > $replyMinLength WITH p, count(DISTINCT reply) AS c WHERE c > 5 MATCH (p)-[:LIKES]->(liked:Post)-[:HAS_TAG]->(tag:Tag) WHERE liked.creationDate < $likedBefore RETURN tag.name AS tagName, count(DISTINCT p) AS likerCount ORDER BY likerCount DESC LIMIT 20

nl: Find authors of recent tagged posts who are active in the most matching forums, then rank the countries where their friends work.
cypher: MATCH (po:Post)-[:HAS_CREATOR]->(author:Person)<-[:HAS_MEMBER]-(fo:Forum)-[:HAS_TAG]->(tag:Tag) WHERE po.creationDate > $postDate AND tag.name = $tagName WITH author, count(DISTINCT fo) AS c ORDER BY c DESC LIMIT 100 MATCH (author)-[:KNOWS]->(friend:Person)-[:WORK_AT]->(comp:Company)-[:IS_LOCATED_IN]->(country:Country) WHERE friend.gender = $gender RETURN country.name AS countryName, count(DISTINCT friend) AS friendCount ORDER BY friendCount DESC LIMIT 20

nl: Select the top tags used on long posts within tag classes that have subclasses, then rank where interested students study.
cypher: MATCH (po:Post)-[:HAS_TAG]->(tag:Tag)-[:HAS_TYPE]->(tc:TagClass)<-[:IS_SUBCLASS_OF]-(sub:TagClass) WHERE po.length > $minPostLength WITH tag, count(DISTINCT po) AS c ORDER BY c DESC LIMIT 1000 MATCH (tag)<-[:HAS_INTEREST]-(person:Person)-[:STUDY_AT]->(univ:University)-[:IS_LOCATED_IN]->(place:Place) WHERE person.browserUsed = $browserUsed RETURN place.name AS placeName, count(DISTINCT person) AS personCount ORDER BY personCount DESC LIMIT 20

nl: Identify countries with many company workers associated with posts from a time window, then rank browsers used by residents who create long comments there.
cypher: MATCH (po:Post)-[:IS_LOCATED_IN]->(country:Country)<-[:IS_LOCATED_IN]-(co:Company)<-[:WORK_AT]-(worker:Person) WHERE po.creationDate < $beforeDate AND co.name <> $excludedCompany WITH country, count(DISTINCT worker) AS c ORDER BY c DESC LIMIT 6 MATCH (country)<-[:IS_PART_OF]-(city:City)<-[:IS_LOCATED_IN]-(resident:Person)<-[:HAS_CREATOR]-(comment:Comment) WHERE comment.length > $minCommentLength RETURN resident.browserUsed AS browserUsed, count(DISTINCT comment) AS commentCount ORDER BY commentCount DESC LIMIT 20

nl: Find post creators whose interests overlap tags on long comments, then rank moderator browsers for forums containing those creators’ later messages.
cypher: MATCH (po:Post)-[:HAS_CREATOR]->(creator:Person)-[:HAS_INTEREST]->(tag:Tag)<-[:HAS_TAG]-(comment:Comment) WHERE po.browserUsed = $postBrowser AND comment.length > $minCommentLength WITH creator, count(DISTINCT comment) AS c ORDER BY c DESC LIMIT 100 MATCH (creator)<-[:HAS_CREATOR]-(msg:Message)<-[:CONTAINER_OF]-(forum:Forum)-[:HAS_MODERATOR]->(moderator:Person) WHERE msg.creationDate > $messageDate AND moderator.gender = $moderatorGender RETURN moderator.browserUsed AS moderatorBrowser, count(DISTINCT msg) AS messageCount ORDER BY messageCount DESC LIMIT 20
